  rw [hL, hR, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hlogρ : Real.log (r / ρ) ≤ Real.log r := by
    rw [Real.log_div hr₀.ne' hρ₀.ne']
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hρ]
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D 0 : ℝ) * Real.log r :=
    mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hD' 0) (Real.log_nonneg (by linarith))
  have key : ∀ z ∈ hfin.toFinset, (D.toClosedBall ρ z : ℝ) * Real.log (r / ρ)
      ≤ (D.toClosedBall r z : ℝ) * Real.log (r * ‖z‖⁻¹)
        + (if z = 0 then (D 0 : ℝ) * Real.log r else 0) := by
    intro z _
    by_cases hz0 : z = 0
    · subst hz0
      have h1 : D.toClosedBall ρ 0 = D 0 := toClosedBall_eval_within D (by simp)
      have h3 : (D.toClosedBall r 0 : ℝ) * Real.log (r * ‖(0 : ℂ)‖⁻¹) = 0 := by simp
      rw [h1, h3, zero_add, if_pos rfl]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogρ (by exact_mod_cast hD' 0)
    · rw [if_neg hz0, add_zero]
      have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz0
      by_cases hzρ : ‖z‖ ≤ ρ
      · have hmρ : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |ρ| := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, habsρ]
          exact hzρ
        have hmr : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |r| := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, habsr]
          linarith
        rw [toClosedBall_eval_within D hmρ, toClosedBall_eval_within D hmr]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by exact_mod_cast hD' z)
        rw [Real.log_div hr₀.ne' hρ₀.ne', Real.log_mul hr₀.ne' (inv_ne_zero hzpos.ne'),
          Real.log_inv]
        have hl : Real.log ‖z‖ ≤ Real.log ρ := by
          first
            | exact Real.log_le_log hzpos hzρ
            | exact (Real.log_le_log_iff hzpos hρ₀).mpr hzρ
        linarith
      · have hnρ : z ∉ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |ρ| := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, habsρ]
          exact hzρ
        rw [apply_eq_zero_of_notMem (D.toClosedBall ρ) hnρ, Int.cast_zero, zero_mul]
        by_cases hzr : ‖z‖ ≤ r
        · refine mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpos r z) ?_
          rw [Real.log_mul hr₀.ne' (inv_ne_zero hzpos.ne'), Real.log_inv]
          have hl : Real.log ‖z‖ ≤ Real.log r := by
            first
              | exact Real.log_le_log hzpos hzr
              | exact (Real.log_le_log_iff hzpos hr₀).mpr hzr
          linarith
        · have hnr : z ∉ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |r| := by
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, habsr]
            exact hzr
          have h0 : D.toClosedBall r z = 0 := apply_eq_zero_of_notMem (D.toClosedBall r) hnr
          rw [h0]
          simp
  have hsum : ∑ z ∈ hfin.toFinset, (if z = 0 then (D 0 : ℝ) * Real.log r else 0)
      ≤ (D 0 : ℝ) * Real.log r := by
    first
      | rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
      | simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs <;> linarith
  have hkey := Finset.sum_le_sum key
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hkey
  linarith

classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hO.bound
  obtain ⟨N, hCN⟩ := exists_nat_gt C
  by_contra hinf
  obtain ⟨t, htsub, htcard⟩ : ∃ t : Finset E, (t : Set E) ⊆ D.support ∧ t.card = N := by
    first
      | exact Set.Infinite.exists_subset_card_eq hinf N
      | exact Set.Infinite.exists_subset_card_eq (s := D.support) hinf N
  have happ : ∀ (s : Finset E) (w : E),
      (∑ z ∈ s, single z (1 : ℤ) : locallyFinsupp E ℤ) w
        = ∑ z ∈ s, (single z (1 : ℤ) : locallyFinsupp E ℤ) w := by
    intro s w
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · first
        | (simp; done)
        | (simp only [Finset.sum_empty]; done)
        | (simp only [Finset.sum_empty]; rfl)
        | rfl
    · intro a s ha ih
      first
        | (rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, coe_add, Pi.add_apply, ih]; done)
        | (rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, ← ih]; done)
        | (rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, ← ih]; rfl)
        | (simp [Finset.sum_insert ha, ih]; done)
  have hle : (∑ z ∈ t, single z (1 : ℤ) : locallyFinsupp E ℤ) ≤ D := by
    intro w
    have h0 : 0 ≤ D w := by
      first
        | exact h w
        | simpa using h w
    rw [happ t w]
    first
      | simp only [single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
      | simp only [single_apply]
      | simp only [Pi.single_apply]
    first
      | rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      | rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
      | simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs with hw
    · have h1 : D w ≠ 0 := by
        have hmem := htsub (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hw)
        first
          | exact hmem
          | simpa using hmem
      omega
    · exact h0
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ : ∃ R₀ : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ t, ‖z‖ ≤ R₀ := by
    refine ⟨∑ z ∈ t, ‖z‖, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => norm_nonneg i) hz
  have hEq : ∀ᶠ r in atTop, logCounting (∑ z ∈ t, single z (1 : ℤ) : locallyFinsupp E ℤ) r
      = (N : ℝ) * Real.log r - ∑ z ∈ t, Real.log ‖z‖ := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop R₀] with r hr
    have hterm : ∀ z ∈ t, logCounting (single z (1 : ℤ)) r = Real.log r - Real.log ‖z‖ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [logCounting_single_eq_log_sub_const ((hR₀ z hz).trans hr)]
      simp
    first
      | (rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
          Finset.sum_const, htcard, nsmul_eq_mul]; done)
      | (rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
         simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, htcard])
  have hFinal : ∀ᶠ r in atTop, ((N : ℝ) - C) * Real.log r ≤ ∑ z ∈ t, Real.log ‖z‖ := by
    filter_upwards [hC, hEq, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with r hr1 hr2 hr3
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log r := Real.log_nonneg hr3
    have h4 := logCounting_le hle hr3
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hr1
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hlog] at hr1
    have h5 : logCounting D r ≤ C * Real.log r := le_trans (le_abs_self _) hr1
    have hexp : ((N : ℝ) - C) * Real.log r = (N : ℝ) * Real.log r - C * Real.log r := by ring
    rw [hexp]
    linarith
  have hTendsto : Tendsto (fun r ↦ ((N : ℝ) - C) * Real.log r) atTop atTop := by
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) - C := by linarith
    first
      | exact Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hpos Real.tendsto_log_atTop
      | exact (Filter.tendsto_const_mul_atTop_of_pos hpos).mpr Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  obtain ⟨r, hr₁, hr₂⟩ :=
    (hFinal.and (hTendsto.eventually_gt_atTop (∑ z ∈ t, Real.log ‖z‖))).exists
  have hr₂' : ∑ z ∈ t, Real.log ‖z‖ < ((N : ℝ) - C) * Real.log r := hr₂
  linarith

obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ, g.toEuler = euler g.h ρ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← convs_toEuler_of_forall_le hB n le_rfl, hρ, convs_euler]
  have hj_zero : (ρ.get? 0).getD 0 = (g.partNums.get? 0).getD 0 / g.dens 1 := by
    have h0 := toEuler_s_zero (g := g)
    rw [hρ, euler_s_zero] at h0
    rcases hg : g.s.get? 0 with _ | ⟨a, b⟩ <;> rcases hr : ρ.get? 0 with _ | r <;>
      rw [hg, hr] at h0
    · simp [partNums, hg]
    · simp at h0
    · simp at h0
    · have h1 : r = a / b := (Pair.mk.inj (Option.some.inj h0)).1
      subst h1
      simp [partNums, hg, first_den_eq hg]
  have hj_succ (j : ℕ) : (ρ.get? (j + 1)).getD 0 =
      -(g.partNums.get? (j + 1)).getD 0 * g.dens j / g.dens (j + 1 + 1) := by
    have h0 := toEuler_s_succ (g := g) (n := j)
    rw [hρ, euler_s_succ] at h0
    rcases hg : g.s.get? (j + 1) with _ | ⟨a, b⟩ <;> rcases hr : ρ.get? (j + 1) with _ | r <;>
      rw [hg, hr] at h0
    · simp [partNums, hg]
    · simp at h0
    · simp at h0
    · have h1 : -r = a * g.dens j / g.dens (j + 1 + 1) := (Pair.mk.inj (Option.some.inj h0)).1
      have h2 : g.partNums.get? (j + 1) = some a := by simp [partNums, hg]
      simp only [h2, Option.getD_some]
      linear_combination -h1
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    simp only [zero_add, Finset.prod_range_one, hj_zero, zeroth_den_eq_one, neg_neg, one_mul]
  | succ i' ih =>
    have h0 : g.dens i' ≠ 0 := hB i' (by omega)
    have h1 : g.dens (i' + 1) ≠ 0 := hB (i' + 1) (by omega)
    have h2 : g.dens (i' + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hB (i' + 1 + 1) (by omega)
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ _ (i' + 1), Finset.prod_range_succ _ (i' + 1), ih (by omega),
      hj_succ]
    first
    | linear_combination ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range (i' + 1), -(g.partNums.get? j).getD 0) *
        (g.partNums.get? (i' + 1)).getD 0 * (g.dens (i' + 1))⁻¹ * (g.dens (i' + 1 + 1))⁻¹) *
        mul_inv_cancel₀ h0
    | (field_simp; ring)
    | field_simp

cases nonempty_fintype G
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : B → L, ∀ s, T s = algebraMap (B ⧸ Q) L (algebraMap B (B ⧸ Q) s) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  have comm₁ : (algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap (A ⧸ P) K) =
      (algebraMap (B ⧸ Q) L).comp (algebraMap (A ⧸ P) (B ⧸ Q)) :=
    (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (A ⧸ P) K L).symm.trans
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (A ⧸ P) (B ⧸ Q) L)
  have comm₂ : (algebraMap (A ⧸ P) (B ⧸ Q)).comp (algebraMap A (A ⧸ P)) =
      (algebraMap B (B ⧸ Q)).comp (algebraMap A B) := by
    first
      | exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A (A ⧸ P) (B ⧸ Q)).symm.trans
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B (B ⧸ Q))
      | exact RingHom.ext fun a ↦ rfl
      | (ext a; simp)
  have hφ : (algebraMap K L).comp ((algebraMap (A ⧸ P) K).comp (algebraMap A (A ⧸ P))) =
      ((algebraMap (B ⧸ Q) L).comp (algebraMap B (B ⧸ Q))).comp (algebraMap A B) := by
    rw [← RingHom.comp_assoc, comm₁, RingHom.comp_assoc, comm₂, RingHom.comp_assoc]
  have key : ∀ s : B, ∃ f : K[X], f.Monic ∧
      f.map (algebraMap K L) = ∏ g : G, (X - C (T (g • s))) ∧
      Polynomial.aeval (T s) f = 0 := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨p, hp, -, hpm⟩ : ∃ p : A[X], p.map (algebraMap A B) = MulSemiringAction.charpoly G s ∧
        p.natDegree = (MulSemiringAction.charpoly G s).natDegree ∧ p.Monic := by
      first
        | exact Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic
            (Algebra.IsInvariant.charpoly_mem_lifts (A := A) (B := B) (G := G) s)
            (MulSemiringAction.monic_charpoly (G := G) s)
        | exact Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic
            (Algebra.IsInvariant.charpoly_mem_lifts A B G s) (MulSemiringAction.monic_charpoly G s)
    have hmap : (p.map ((algebraMap (A ⧸ P) K).comp (algebraMap A (A ⧸ P)))).map
        (algebraMap K L) = ∏ g : G, (X - C (T (g • s))) := by
      rw [Polynomial.map_map, hφ, ← Polynomial.map_map, hp]
      first
        | rw [MulSemiringAction.charpoly_eq, Polynomial.map_prod]
        | rw [MulSemiringAction.charpoly, Polynomial.map_prod]
      simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C, RingHom.comp_apply, hT]
    refine ⟨p.map ((algebraMap (A ⧸ P) K).comp (algebraMap A (A ⧸ P))), hpm.map _, hmap, ?_⟩
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, ← Polynomial.eval_map, hmap, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ 1) (by simp)
  choose F hFm hFmap hFroot using key
  have hN : ∀ s : B, Normal K (IntermediateField.adjoin K ((F s).rootSet L)) := by
    intro s
    first
      | (have hs : Polynomial.Splits (algebraMap K L) (F s) := by
           rw [← Polynomial.splits_id_iff_splits, hFmap s]
           exact Polynomial.splits_prod _ fun g _ ↦ Polynomial.splits_X_sub_C _
         haveI := IntermediateField.adjoin_rootSet_isSplittingField hs
         exact Normal.of_isSplittingField (F s))
      | (have hs : ((F s).map (algebraMap K L)).Splits := by
           rw [hFmap s]
           first
             | exact Polynomial.Splits.prod fun g _ ↦ Polynomial.Splits.X_sub_C _
             | exact Polynomial.Splits.prod fun g _ ↦ Polynomial.Splits.X_sub_C
         haveI := IntermediateField.adjoin_rootSet_isSplittingField hs
         exact Normal.of_isSplittingField (F s))
      | (have hs : ((F s).map (algebraMap K L)).Factors := by
           rw [hFmap s]
           first
             | exact Polynomial.Factors.prod fun g _ ↦ Polynomial.Factors.X_sub_C _
             | exact Polynomial.Factors.prod fun g _ ↦ Polynomial.Factors.X_sub_C
         haveI := IntermediateField.adjoin_rootSet_isSplittingField hs
         exact Normal.of_isSplittingField (F s))
      | (have hs : Polynomial.Splits (algebraMap K L) (F s) := by
           first
             | exact (Polynomial.splits_id_iff_splits _).1 (by
                 rw [hFmap s]
                 exact Polynomial.splits_prod _ fun g _ ↦ Polynomial.splits_X_sub_C _)
             | (show Polynomial.Factors _
                rw [hFmap s]
                exact Polynomial.Factors.prod fun g _ ↦ Polynomial.Factors.X_sub_C _)
         haveI := IntermediateField.adjoin_rootSet_isSplittingField hs
         exact Normal.of_isSplittingField (F s))
  have hmem : ∀ s : B, T s ∈ ⨆ s : B, IntermediateField.adjoin K ((F s).rootSet L) := by
    intro s
    refine le_iSup (fun s : B ↦ IntermediateField.adjoin K ((F s).rootSet L)) s ?_
    apply IntermediateField.subset_adjoin
    first
      | exact Polynomial.mem_rootSet.2 ⟨(hFm s).ne_zero, hFroot s⟩
      | exact (Polynomial.mem_rootSet_of_ne (hFm s).ne_zero).2 (hFroot s)
  have htop : (⨆ s : B, IntermediateField.adjoin K ((F s).rootSet L)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    obtain ⟨y, z, -, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := B ⧸ Q) x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    have hy := hmem y
    have hz := hmem z
    rw [hT] at hy hz
    exact div_mem hy hz
  haveI hsup : Normal K (⨆ s : B, IntermediateField.adjoin K ((F s).rootSet L) :
      IntermediateField K L) := by
    first
      | infer_instance
      | exact IntermediateField.normal_iSup _
  exact Normal.of_algEquiv ((IntermediateField.equivOfEq htop).trans IntermediateField.topEquiv)

have nonZero (α : b.support) : (α : Weight K H L).IsNonZero := by
    first
    | exact H.isNonZero_coe_root α
    | exact H.isNonZero_coe_root α.1
    | simpa [LieSubalgebra.root] using α.1.2
  choose h e f ht he hf using
    fun α : b.support ↦ exists_isSl2Triple_of_weight_isNonZero (nonZero α)
  have h_coroot (i : b.support) : h i = (rootSystem H).coroot i := by
    first
    | exact (ht i).h_eq_coroot (nonZero i) (he i) (hf i)
    | simpa using (ht i).h_eq_coroot (nonZero i) (he i) (hf i)
  simp_rw [h_coroot] at ht
  first
  | refine' ⟨Basis.mk (A := b.cartanMatrix) (e := e) (f := f)
      (h := fun i ↦ (rootSystem H).coroot i) .., rfl, fun i ↦ rfl⟩
  | refine' ⟨{ A := b.cartanMatrix, e := e, f := f,
      h := fun i ↦ (rootSystem H).coroot i, .. }, rfl, fun i ↦ rfl⟩
  | refine' ⟨Basis.mk (A := b.cartanMatrix) (e := e) (f := f) .., rfl, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  all_goals first
    | exact ht
    | exact fun i ↦ ht i
    | exact lieSpan_range_union_eq_top_of_mem_rootSpace b e f ht he hf
    | exact cartan_eq_lieSpan b
    | exact (cartan_eq_lieSpan b).symm
    | exact (ht _).lie_e_f
    | exact fun i ↦ by rw [(ht i).lie_e_f]; exact ht i
    | (intro i j
       have key := lie_eq_smul_of_mem_rootSpace (he j) ((rootSystem H).coroot i)
       rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, ← eq_intCast (algebraMap ℤ K),
         RootPairing.Base.algebraMap_cartanMatrixIn_apply]
       simpa using key)
    | (intro i j
       have key := lie_eq_smul_of_mem_rootSpace (hf j) ((rootSystem H).coroot i)
       rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
       try rw [Int.cast_neg]
       rw [← eq_intCast (algebraMap ℤ K), RootPairing.Base.algebraMap_cartanMatrixIn_apply]
       simpa using key)
    | (intro i j
       simp [← LieSubalgebra.coe_bracket])
    | (intro i j hij
       by_contra hne
       have hmem := lie_mem_genWeightSpace_of_mem_genWeightSpace (he i) (hf j)
       have hne_bot : genWeightSpace L (⇑(i : Weight K H L) + -⇑(j : Weight K H L)) ≠ ⊥ := by
         intro hbot
         rw [hbot, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hmem
         exact hne hmem
       let χ : Weight K H L := ⟨_, hne_bot⟩
       have hχ : χ.IsNonZero := by
         intro hχ0
         apply hij
         have h1 : ∀ x, (i : Weight K H L) x = (j : Weight K H L) x := by
           intro x
           have h2 : (i : Weight K H L) x + -(j : Weight K H L) x = 0 := congrFun hχ0 x
           linear_combination h2
         exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (Weight.ext h1))
       have hχmem : χ ∈ H.root := by
         first
         | simpa using hχ
         | simpa [LieSubalgebra.root] using hχ
         | exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hχ⟩
       have hr : (rootSystem H).root i - (rootSystem H).root j ∈ range (rootSystem H).root := by
         refine ⟨⟨χ, hχmem⟩, LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_⟩
         show (i : Weight K H L) x + -(j : Weight K H L) x =
           (i : Weight K H L) x - (j : Weight K H L) x
         exact (sub_eq_add_neg _ _).symm
       first
       | exact b.sub_notMem_range_root i.2 j.2 hr
       | exact b.sub_nmem_range_root i.2 j.2 hr)

set S := lieSpan K L (range e ∪ range f) with hS
  have e_mem_S (i : b.support) : e i ∈ S :=
    subset_lieSpan (Set.mem_union_left _ (mem_range_self i))
  have f_mem_S (i : b.support) : f i ∈ S :=
    subset_lieSpan (Set.mem_union_right _ (mem_range_self i))
  have hH : H ≤ S := by
    refine (cartan_eq_lieSpan b).le.trans (lieSpan_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have := S.lie_mem (e_mem_S i) (f_mem_S i)
    rw [(ef_sl2 i).lie_e_f] at this
    exact this
  suffices hroot : ∀ α : H.root, ∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have hx : x ∈ (⨆ χ : Weight K H L, genWeightSpace L χ) := by
      rw [LieModule.iSup_genWeightSpace_eq_top']
      exact LieSubmodule.mem_top x
    first
    | refine LieSubmodule.iSup_induction _ hx (fun χ y hy ↦ ?_) S.zero_mem (fun _ _ ↦ S.add_mem)
    | refine LieSubmodule.iSup_induction (C := fun y ↦ y ∈ S) _ hx (fun χ y hy ↦ ?_) S.zero_mem
        (fun _ _ ↦ S.add_mem)
    | refine LieSubmodule.iSup_induction (motive := fun y ↦ y ∈ S) _ hx (fun χ y hy ↦ ?_)
        S.zero_mem (fun _ _ ↦ S.add_mem)
    by_cases hχ : χ.IsZero
    · have h1 : (⇑χ : H → K) = 0 := hχ
      have h2 : y ∈ rootSpace H (0 : H → K) := by
        rw [← h1]
        exact hy
      rw [rootSpace_zero_eq] at h2
      first
      | exact hH h2
      | exact hH ((LieSubalgebra.mem_toLieSubmodule _).mp h2)
    · exact hroot ⟨χ, hχ⟩ y hy
  suffices h : ∀ α : H.root, (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) from fun α ↦ (h α).1
  have hspan : ∀ (α : H → K), α ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ rootSpace H α, z ≠ 0 → z ∈ S →
      ∀ y ∈ rootSpace H α, y ∈ S := by
    intro α hα0 z hz hz0 hzS y hy
    have hα : genWeightSpace L α ≠ ⊥ := (LieSubmodule.ne_bot_iff _).mpr ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp
      (by rwa [← toSubmodule_rootSpace_eq_span (⟨α, hα⟩ : Weight K H L) hα0 z hz0 hz] :
        y ∈ Submodule.span K {z})
    exact S.smul_mem t hzS
  have hstep : ∀ (α β γ : H → K), genWeightSpace L β ≠ ⊥ → α ≠ 0 → γ ≠ 0 → γ = α + β →
      ∀ a ∈ rootSpace H α, a ≠ 0 → a ∈ S → (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H β, y ∈ S) →
      genWeightSpace L γ ≠ ⊥ → ∀ y ∈ rootSpace H γ, y ∈ S := by
    intro α β γ hβ hα0 hγ0 hαβγ a ha ha0 haS hβS hγ
    have hα : genWeightSpace L α ≠ ⊥ := (LieSubmodule.ne_bot_iff _).mpr ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩
    have h_ne_bot : rootSpace H (α + β) ≠ ⊥ := by
      rw [← hαβγ]
      exact hγ
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hac⟩ := exists_mem_rootSpace_lie_ne_zero' (α := ⟨α, hα⟩) (β := ⟨β, hβ⟩)
      hα0 h_ne_bot ha ha0
    have hmem : ⁅a, c⁆ ∈ rootSpace H γ := by
      rw [hαβγ]
      exact lie_mem_genWeightSpace_of_mem_genWeightSpace ha hc
    exact hspan γ hγ0 ⁅a, c⁆ hmem hac (S.lie_mem haS (hβS c hc))
  have hnz : ∀ α : H.root, (⇑α.1 : H → K) ≠ 0 := fun α ↦ by
    first
    | exact α.2
    | exact Weight.coe_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr α.2
    | simpa [Weight.IsNonZero, Weight.IsZero] using α.2
  have hnb : ∀ α : H.root, genWeightSpace L (⇑α.1 : H → K) ≠ ⊥ :=
    fun α ↦ α.1.genWeightSpace_ne_bot
  have hconv : ∀ α β γ : H.root,
      (rootSystem H).root γ = (rootSystem H).root α + (rootSystem H).root β →
      (⇑γ.1 : H → K) = ⇑α.1 + ⇑β.1 := by
    intro α β γ h
    ext x
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
    first
    | simpa using this
    | exact this
    | simpa [rootSystem_root_apply] using this
  have hconv' : ∀ α β : H.root,
      (rootSystem H).root β = -(rootSystem H).root α → (⇑β.1 : H → K) = -⇑α.1 := by
    intro α β h
    ext x
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
    first
    | simpa using this
    | exact this
    | simpa [rootSystem_root_apply] using this
  have hrefl : ∀ α : H.root,
      (⇑((rootSystem H).reflectionPerm α α).1 : H → K) = -⇑α.1 := by
    intro α
    apply hconv'
    first
    | rw [RootPairing.root_reflectionPerm, RootPairing.reflection_apply_self]
    | simp [RootPairing.root_reflectionPerm]
    | simp
  have hnb' : ∀ α : H.root, genWeightSpace L (-⇑α.1 : H → K) ≠ ⊥ := fun α ↦ by
    first
    | exact (-α.1).genWeightSpace_ne_bot
    | (rw [← hrefl α]; exact hnb _)
  have hsimple : ∀ α : H.root, α ∈ b.support →
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) := by
    intro α hα
    exact ⟨hspan _ (hnz α) (e ⟨α, hα⟩) (e_mem ⟨α, hα⟩) (ef_sl2 ⟨α, hα⟩).e_ne_zero
        (e_mem_S ⟨α, hα⟩),
      hspan _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr (hnz α)) (f ⟨α, hα⟩) (f_mem ⟨α, hα⟩)
        (ef_sl2 ⟨α, hα⟩).f_ne_zero (f_mem_S ⟨α, hα⟩)⟩
  have hadd : ∀ α β γ : H.root,
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) → β ∈ b.support →
      (⇑γ.1 : H → K) = ⇑α.1 + ⇑β.1 →
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑γ.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑γ.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) := by
    intro α β γ hα hβ hγ
    refine ⟨hstep (⇑β.1) (⇑α.1) (⇑γ.1) (hnb α) (hnz β) (hnz γ)
        (by rw [hγ]; exact add_comm _ _) (e ⟨β, hβ⟩) (e_mem ⟨β, hβ⟩)
        (ef_sl2 ⟨β, hβ⟩).e_ne_zero (e_mem_S ⟨β, hβ⟩) hα.1 (hnb γ),
      hstep (-⇑β.1) (-⇑α.1) (-⇑γ.1) (hnb' α) (neg_ne_zero.mpr (hnz β))
        (neg_ne_zero.mpr (hnz γ)) (by rw [hγ, neg_add]; exact add_comm _ _) (f ⟨β, hβ⟩)
        (f_mem ⟨β, hβ⟩) (ef_sl2 ⟨β, hβ⟩).f_ne_zero (f_mem_S ⟨β, hβ⟩) hα.2 (hnb' γ)⟩
  have hneg' : ∀ α β : H.root,
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) →
      (⇑β.1 : H → K) = -⇑α.1 →
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑β.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑β.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) := by
    rintro α β ⟨h1, h2⟩ hβ
    rw [hβ, neg_neg]
    exact ⟨h2, h1⟩
  have hneg : ∀ α : H.root,
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) →
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑((rootSystem H).reflectionPerm α α).1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑((rootSystem H).reflectionPerm α α).1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) :=
    fun α hα ↦ hneg' α _ hα (hrefl α)
  first
  | refine fun α ↦ b.induction_add α ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
    first
    | exact hsimple
    | exact hneg
    | (intros; apply hsimple; assumption)
    | (intros; apply hneg; assumption)
    | (intros; apply hadd <;>
        first
        | assumption
        | exact hconv _ _ _ ‹_›
        | exact hconv _ _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›)
        | exact (hconv _ _ _ ‹_›).trans (add_comm _ _)
        | exact (hconv _ _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›)).trans (add_comm _ _))
    | (intros; apply hneg' <;>
        first
        | assumption
        | exact hconv' _ _ ‹_›
        | exact hconv' _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›))
  | refine fun α ↦ b.induction_add ?_ ?_ ?_ α <;>
    first
    | exact hsimple
    | exact hneg
    | (intros; apply hsimple; assumption)
    | (intros; apply hneg; assumption)
    | (intros; apply hadd <;>
        first
        | assumption
        | exact hconv _ _ _ ‹_›
        | exact hconv _ _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›)
        | exact (hconv _ _ _ ‹_›).trans (add_comm _ _)
        | exact (hconv _ _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›)).trans (add_comm _ _))
    | (intros; apply hneg' <;>
        first
        | assumption
        | exact hconv' _ _ ‹_›
        | exact hconv' _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›))
  | refine b.induction_add ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
    first
    | exact hsimple
    | exact hneg
    | (intros; apply hsimple; assumption)
    | (intros; apply hneg; assumption)
    | (intros; apply hadd <;>
        first
        | assumption
        | exact hconv _ _ _ ‹_›
        | exact hconv _ _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›)
        | exact (hconv _ _ _ ‹_›).trans (add_comm _ _)
        | exact (hconv _ _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›)).trans (add_comm _ _))
    | (intros; apply hneg' <;>
        first
        | assumption
        | exact hconv' _ _ ‹_›
        | exact hconv' _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›))
  | intro α
    induction α using b.induction_add <;>
    first
    | (intros; apply hsimple; assumption)
    | (intros; apply hneg; assumption)
    | (intros; apply hadd <;>
        first
        | assumption
        | exact hconv _ _ _ ‹_›
        | exact hconv _ _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›)
        | exact (hconv _ _ _ ‹_›).trans (add_comm _ _)
        | exact (hconv _ _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›)).trans (add_comm _ _))
    | (intros; apply hneg' <;>
        first
        | assumption
        | exact hconv' _ _ ‹_›
        | exact hconv' _ _ (Eq.symm ‹_›))

have hD : ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[K] V, finrank K (V ⧸ g.fixedSubmodule) ≤ 1 →
      g ∈ dilatransvections K V := by
    intro g hg
    rw [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank]
    first
      | exact hg
      | refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hg
        rw [fixedSubmodule_eq_ker]
        exact (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange _).finrank_eq.symm
      | have := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank g.fixedSubmodule
        omega
  have hfixOf : ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[K] V, g.fixedReduce = 1 → ∀ x, g x - x ∈ g.fixedSubmodule := by
    intro g hg x
    have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun hg (Submodule.Quotient.mk x)
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.eq]
    first
      | exact h1
      | simpa using h1
      | simpa [fixedReduce] using h1
  have hredOf : ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[K] V, (∀ x, g x - x ∈ g.fixedSubmodule) → g.fixedReduce = 1 := by
    intro g hg
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
    have h1 := hg x
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.eq] at h1
    first
      | exact h1
      | simpa using h1
      | simpa [fixedReduce] using h1
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) = n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  induction n generalizing e with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1 = 0 := by omega
    rw [h0, pow_zero, one_mul]
    exact hD e (by omega)
  | succ n hind =>
    rcases n with _ | m
    · have h0 : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1 = 0 := by omega
      rw [h0, pow_zero, one_mul]
      exact hD e (by omega)
    · have hfix := hfixOf e he
      have h1 : 1 < finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) := by omega
      obtain ⟨u, -, hu⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (sup_span_singleton_lt_top 0 h1)
      have hu' : u ∉ e.fixedSubmodule := fun h => hu (Submodule.mem_sup_left h)
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ :=
        (LinearPMap.supSpanSingleton ⟨e.fixedSubmodule, 0⟩ u (1 : K) hu').toFun.exists_extend
      have hfu : f u = 1 := by
        have := LinearPMap.supSpanSingleton_apply_mk ⟨e.fixedSubmodule, 0⟩ u (1 : K) hu' 0
          (Submodule.zero_mem _) 1
        simpa using (LinearMap.congr_fun hf _).trans this
      have hf0 : ∀ x ∈ e.fixedSubmodule, f x = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        have := LinearPMap.supSpanSingleton_apply_mk ⟨e.fixedSubmodule, 0⟩ u (1 : K) hu' x hx 0
        simpa using (LinearMap.congr_fun hf _).trans this
      have hle : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e u - u) ≤ LinearMap.ker f := by
        rw [sup_le_iff, Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
        exact ⟨fun x hx => LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (hf0 x hx),
          LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (hf0 _ (hfix u))⟩
      have hτ : f (e u - u) = 0 := hf0 _ (hfix u)
      have hfue : f (u - e u) = 0 := by
        rw [← neg_sub, map_neg, hτ, neg_zero]
      have ht_apply : ∀ y, auxTransvection hle y = y + f y • (u - e u) := by
        intro y
        first
          | rfl
          | simp [auxTransvection, LinearMap.transvection.apply]
          | simp [auxTransvection, transvection.apply]
          | simp [auxTransvection]
      have hτ_apply : ∀ y, transvection hτ y = y + f y • (e u - u) := by
        intro y
        first
          | rfl
          | exact transvection.apply hτ y
          | simp [LinearMap.transvection.apply]
          | simp [transvection.apply]
      have hτt : transvection hτ * auxTransvection hle = 1 := by
        ext y
        show transvection hτ (auxTransvection hle y) = y
        have hfy : f (y + f y • (u - e u)) = f y := by
          first
            | rw [map_add, map_smul, hfue, smul_zero, add_zero]
            | rw [map_add, LinearMap.map_smul, hfue, smul_zero, add_zero]
            | simp [hfue]
        rw [ht_apply, hτ_apply, hfy, add_assoc, ← smul_add, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_self,
          smul_zero, add_zero]
      have hfixte : ∀ x, (auxTransvection hle * e) x - x ∈
          (auxTransvection hle * e).fixedSubmodule := by
        intro x
        rw [auxTransvection_mul_fixed (hf := hle) hfu, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ht_apply]
        apply Submodule.mem_sup_left
        have h2 : u - e u ∈ e.fixedSubmodule := by
          rw [← neg_sub]
          exact neg_mem (hfix u)
        rw [add_sub_right_comm]
        first
          | exact add_mem (hfix x) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h2)
          | exact add_mem (hfix x) (Submodule.smul_mem _ h2)
      have hrank : finrank K (V ⧸ (auxTransvection hle * e).fixedSubmodule) = m + 1 := by
        have := finrank_mod_auxTransvection_mul_fixed (hf := hle) hfu hu'
        omega
      have key := hind (e := auxTransvection hle * e) (hredOf _ hfixte) hrank
      have hexp1 : finrank K (V ⧸ (auxTransvection hle * e).fixedSubmodule) - 1 = m := by
        omega
      rw [hexp1] at key
      have hτmem : transvection hτ ∈ transvections K V := by
        first
          | exact transvection_mem_transvections hτ
          | exact ⟨f, e u - u, hτ, rfl⟩
          | exact mem_transvections hτ
          | exact ⟨e u - u, f, hτ, rfl⟩
          | exact ⟨⟨(f, e u - u), hτ⟩, rfl⟩
      have he' : transvection hτ * (auxTransvection hle * e) = e := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, hτt, one_mul]
      have hmem := Set.mul_mem_mul hτmem key
      rw [he'] at hmem
      have hexp : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1 = m + 1 := by omega
      rw [hexp, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
      exact hmem

induction h : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) generalizing e he with
  | zero => simp [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient, h]
  | succ n hind =>
    match n with
    | 0 => simp [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient, h]
    | n + 1 =>
      try simp only [add_tsub_cancel_right] at hind
      have h1 : 1 < finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) := by omega
      obtain ⟨f, v, hv, hf, hfv⟩ := exists_dual_of_fixedReduce_ne_smul he h1
      have hvW : v ∉ e.fixedSubmodule := fun hv' => by
        have h0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hf (Submodule.mem_sup_left hv'))
        rw [hfv] at h0
        exact one_ne_zero h0
      suffices H : ∃ (f' : Dual K V) (hf' : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ≤ LinearMap.ker f'),
          auxTransvection hf' * e ∈ transvections K V ^ n * dilatransvections K V by
        obtain ⟨f', hf', hmem⟩ := H
        have hT : (auxTransvection hf')⁻¹ ∈ transvections K V := by
          rw [inv_mem_transvections_iff]
          apply mem_transvections
        have key := Set.mul_mem_mul hT hmem
        rw [inv_mul_cancel_left] at key
        rw [add_tsub_cancel_right, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
        exact key
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
        have h2 := finrank_mod_auxTransvection_mul_fixed (hf := hf) hfv hvW
        have h3 : finrank K (V ⧸ (auxTransvection hf * e).fixedSubmodule) = 1 := by omega
        first
        | (rw [pow_zero, one_mul, mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient]; omega)
        | simp [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient, h3]
      · have hne_top : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ⊔ K ∙ v < ⊤ := by
          have h4 := finrank_quotient_sup_span_singleton hvW
          have h5 : 1 < finrank K (V ⧸ (e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v)) := by omega
          rw [sup_right_comm]
          exact sup_span_singleton_lt_top (e v - v) h5
        obtain ⟨u, -, hu⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hne_top
        obtain ⟨g, hgu, hg⟩ := Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hu inferInstance
        have hgP : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ⊔ K ∙ v ≤ LinearMap.ker g := by
          rwa [LinearMap.le_ker_iff_map]
        have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hgu (by simp [h0])
        have hgv : g v = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp
          (hgP (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self v)))
        have hfg : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ≤ LinearMap.ker (f + g) := by
          intro x hx
          rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hf hx),
            LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hgP (Submodule.mem_sup_left hx)), add_zero]
        have hfgv : (f + g) v = 1 := by
          rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hfv, hgv, add_zero]
        by_cases hA : ∀ a : K, ∃ x, (auxTransvection hf * e).fixedReduce x ≠ a • x
        · refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
          have h2 := finrank_mod_auxTransvection_mul_fixed (hf := hf) hfv hvW
          have h3 : finrank K (V ⧸ (auxTransvection hf * e).fixedSubmodule) = n + 1 := by
            omega
          first
          | exact hind hA h3
          | exact hind _ hA h3
          | exact hind h3 hA
          | exact hind _ h3 hA
        · push_neg at hA
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hA
          by_cases hB : ∀ b : K, ∃ x, (auxTransvection hfg * e).fixedReduce x ≠ b • x
          · refine ⟨f + g, hfg, ?_⟩
            have h2 := finrank_mod_auxTransvection_mul_fixed (hf := hfg) hfgv hvW
            have h3 : finrank K (V ⧸ (auxTransvection hfg * e).fixedSubmodule) = n + 1 := by
              omega
            first
            | exact hind hB h3
            | exact hind _ hB h3
            | exact hind h3 hB
            | exact hind _ h3 hB
          · push_neg at hB
            obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hB
            exact (not_forall_fixedReduce_eq_smul (hf := hf) (hg := hfg) hv hfv hfgv hg0
              hne_top ha hb).elim

have hfix : (auxTransvection hf * e).fixedSubmodule = e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v :=
    auxTransvection_mul_fixed hfv
  have hgix : (auxTransvection hg * e).fixedSubmodule = e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v :=
    auxTransvection_mul_fixed hfgv
  have ha' (x : V) : e x + f (e x) • (v - e v) - a • x ∈ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v := by
    have h := ha (Submodule.Quotient.mk x)
    rw [fixedReduce_mk] at h
    have h' : (Submodule.Quotient.mk ((auxTransvection hf * e) x) :
        V ⧸ (auxTransvection hf * e).fixedSubmodule) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (a • x) := by
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
      exact h
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, hfix] at h'
    simpa only [auxTransvection, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, transvection.apply] using h'
  have hb' (x : V) : e x + (f + g) (e x) • (v - e v) - b • x ∈ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v := by
    have h := hb (Submodule.Quotient.mk x)
    rw [fixedReduce_mk] at h
    have h' : (Submodule.Quotient.mk ((auxTransvection hg * e) x) :
        V ⧸ (auxTransvection hg * e).fixedSubmodule) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (b • x) := by
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
      exact h
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, hgix] at h'
    simpa only [auxTransvection, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, transvection.apply] using h'
  have key (x : V) : g (e x) • (v - e v) - (b - a) • x ∈ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v := by
    have h := sub_mem (hb' x) (ha' x)
    have heq : e x + (f + g) (e x) • (v - e v) - b • x - (e x + f (e x) • (v - e v) - a • x)
        = g (e x) • (v - e v) - (b - a) • x := by
      simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, add_smul, sub_smul]
      abel
    rwa [heq] at h
  have hvS : v ∈ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self v)
  rcases eq_or_ne (b - a) 0 with hc | hc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, g y ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h
      exact hg0 (LinearMap.ext fun y ↦ by simp [h y])
    have h2 := key (e.symm y)
    rw [hc, zero_smul, sub_zero, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h2
    have h3 := (e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v).smul_mem (g y)⁻¹ h2
    rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy, one_smul] at h3
    have hev : e v ∈ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v := by
      have h4 := sub_mem hvS h3
      rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at h4
    obtain ⟨w, hw, z, hz, hwz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hev
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
    have h1 : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (e v) : V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) =
        Submodule.Quotient.mk (c • v) := by
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, ← hwz, add_sub_cancel_right]
      exact hw

        intro x
        have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (@g a)) := by

haveI : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime p) := by
    first
      | exact IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing p.primeCompl _ inferInstance
      | infer_instance
  obtain ⟨q, hqdef⟩ : ∃ q : Ideal R[X], q = Ideal.map C (maximalIdeal R) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have qle : q ≤ p := by
    rw [hqdef]
    exact Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (le_of_eq max.symm)
  haveI hqprime : q.IsPrime := by
    rw [hqdef]
    exact Ideal.isPrime_map_C_of_isPrime inferInstance
  have hreg : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : ℕ∞) ≤ (maximalIdeal R).height := by
    have h1 : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R := by
      first
        | exact (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)).le
        | exact (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal R).le
        | exact IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
        | exact (IsRegularLocalRing.reg (R := R)).le
        | exact (IsRegularLocalRing.reg R).le
        | exact IsRegularLocalRing.reg (R := R)
        | exact_mod_cast (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)).le
        | exact_mod_cast (IsRegularLocalRing.reg (R := R)).le
        | exact ((isRegularLocalRing_iff R).1 inferInstance).le
        | exact ((isRegularLocalRing_iff (R := R)).1 inferInstance).le
        | (obtain ⟨-, -, h⟩ := (inferInstance : IsRegularLocalRing R)
           first
             | exact_mod_cast h.le
             | exact_mod_cast h)
    have h2 : ringKrullDim R = (maximalIdeal R).height := by
      first
        | exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim.symm
        | exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim (R := R)).symm
        | (rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]
           exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim.symm)
        | (rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]
           exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim (R := R)).symm)
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have ht : (maximalIdeal R).height ≤ q.height := by
    subst hqdef
    rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]
    have hmono : StrictMono (fun 𝔭 : PrimeSpectrum R ↦
        (⟨𝔭.asIdeal.map C, Ideal.isPrime_map_C_of_isPrime 𝔭.isPrime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R[X])) := by
      intro a b hab
      have hab' : a.asIdeal < b.asIdeal := hab
      show Ideal.map C a.asIdeal < Ideal.map C b.asIdeal
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Ideal.map_mono hab'.le) fun heq ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨r, hrb, hra⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hab'
      have hr : C r ∈ Ideal.map C a.asIdeal := by
        rw [heq]
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem C hrb
      rw [Ideal.mem_map_C_iff] at hr
      exact hra (by simpa using hr 0)
    have h := Order.height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono _ hmono
      (⟨maximalIdeal R, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)
    exact h
  have fgm : (maximalIdeal R).FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  obtain ⟨s, hsfin, hscard, hsspan⟩ : ∃ s : Set R, s.Finite ∧
      s.ncard ≤ (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ∧ Ideal.span s = maximalIdeal R := by
    first
      | exact ⟨_, fgm.finite_generators, fgm.generators_ncard.le, fgm.span_generators⟩
      | exact ⟨_, fgm.finite_generators, fgm.generators_ncard.le, Submodule.span_generators _⟩
      | (obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Submodule.FG.exists_fun_spanFinrank_span_range_eq fgm
         refine ⟨Set.range g, Set.finite_range g, ?_, hg⟩
         rw [← Set.image_univ]
         exact (Set.ncard_image_le (Set.toFinite _)).trans (by simp))
      | (obtain ⟨s, hs1, hs2⟩ := Submodule.FG.exists_span_set_encard_eq_spanFinrank fgm
         have hsf : s.Finite := Set.finite_of_encard_eq_coe hs1
         refine ⟨s, hsf, ?_, hs2⟩

    rw [hqdef, ← hsspan, Ideal.map_span]
  have hsp : ∀ u : Set (Localization.AtPrime p), u.Finite →
      (Ideal.span u).spanFinrank ≤ u.ncard := by
    intro u hu
    first
      | exact Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite hu
      | exact Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard hu
      | (rw [← Set.Nat.card_coe_set_eq]

    first
      | exact Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal.symm
      | exact (Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal (I := p)).symm
      | exact (Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal p).symm
  have hfinal : ((maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)).spanFinrank : ℕ∞) ≤ p.height := by

        rw [hmaxA, ← Ideal.map_span]
        exact congrArg (Ideal.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p))) (hpq.trans hqspan)
      have c1 : (Ideal.span ((algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)) '' (C '' s))).spanFinrank
          ≤ s.ncard :=
        (hsp _ ((hsfin.image _).image _)).trans
          ((Set.ncard_image_le (hsfin.image _)).trans (Set.ncard_image_le hsfin))
      rw [h1]
      calc ((Ideal.span ((algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)) '' (C '' s))).spanFinrank : ℕ∞)
          ≤ (s.ncard : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast c1
        _ ≤ ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hscard
        _ ≤ (maximalIdeal R).height := hreg
        _ ≤ q.height := ht
        _ = p.height := congrArg Ideal.height hpq.symm
    · have hlt : q < p := lt_of_le_of_ne qle (Ne.symm hpq)
      obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : R[X] →+* (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)[X],
          π = Polynomial.mapRingHom (IsLocalRing.residue R) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hπsurj : Function.Surjective π := by
        rw [hπ]
        exact Polynomial.map_surjective _ (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (R := R))
      have hker : RingHom.ker π = q := by
        rw [hπ, Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, IsLocalRing.ker_residue, hqdef]
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g, Ideal.map π p = Ideal.span {g} := by
        first
          | exact (IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal (Ideal.map π p)).principal'
          | exact Submodule.IsPrincipal.principal (Ideal.map π p)
          | exact ⟨_, (Ideal.span_singleton_generator (Ideal.map π p)).symm⟩
      have hgmem : g ∈ Ideal.map π p := by
        rw [hg]
        exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g
      obtain ⟨t, htp, hπt⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective π hπsurj).1 hgmem
      have hple : p ≤ q ⊔ Ideal.span {t} := by
        intro a ha
        have h1 : π a ∈ Ideal.span {g} := by
          rw [← hg]
          exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem π ha
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 h1
        obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := hπsurj c
        have h2 : a - c' * t ∈ q := by
          rw [← hker, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_mul, hπt, hc, sub_self]
        have h3 : a = (a - c' * t) + c' * t := by ring
        rw [h3]
        exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left h2)
          (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self t)))
      have hpeq : p = Ideal.span (insert t (C '' s)) := by
        apply le_antisymm
        · calc p ≤ q ⊔ Ideal.span {t} := hple
            _ = Ideal.span (insert t (C '' s)) := by
              rw [hqspan, ← Ideal.span_union, Set.union_singleton]
        · rw [Ideal.span_le]
          intro x hx
          rcases hx with rfl | hx
          · exact htp
          · exact qle (by rw [hqspan]; exact Ideal.subset_span hx)
      have hht : q.height + 1 ≤ p.height := by
        rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]
        exact Ideal.primeHeight_add_one_le_of_lt hlt
      have hfin : (insert t (C '' s)).Finite := (hsfin.image _).insert t
      have h1 : maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p) =
          Ideal.span ((algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)) '' (insert t (C '' s))) := by
        rw [hmaxA, ← Ideal.map_span]
        exact congrArg (Ideal.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p))) hpeq
      have c2 : (Ideal.span ((algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)) ''
          (insert t (C '' s)))).spanFinrank ≤ s.ncard + 1 :=
        (hsp _ (hfin.image _)).trans ((Set.ncard_image_le hfin).trans
          ((Set.ncard_insert_le t (C '' s)).trans
            (Nat.add_le_add_right (Set.ncard_image_le hsfin) 1)))
      rw [h1]
      calc ((Ideal.span ((algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)) ''
            (insert t (C '' s)))).spanFinrank : ℕ∞)
          ≤ (s.ncard : ℕ∞) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast c2
        _ ≤ ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : ℕ∞) + 1 :=
            add_le_add (by exact_mod_cast hscard) le_rfl
        _ ≤ (maximalIdeal R).height + 1 := add_le_add hreg le_rfl
        _ ≤ q.height + 1 := add_le_add ht le_rfl
        _ ≤ p.height := hht
  have hdimA : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime p) = p.height := by
    first
      | exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height p (Localization.AtPrime p)
      | exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height p _
      | exact Localization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height p
  first
    | (apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
       rw [hdimA]
       exact_mod_cast hfinal)
    | (apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_le
       rw [hdimA]
       exact_mod_cast hfinal)
    | exact ⟨by rw [hdimA]; exact_mod_cast hfinal⟩

classical
  have hpl : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ log⁺ x := fun x => by
    first
      | exact posLog_nonneg
      | exact posLog_nonneg x
      | exact le_max_left _ _

      | exact le_trans posLog_add (le_of_eq (by ring))
      | exact le_trans (posLog_add _ _) (le_of_eq (by ring))

         have h0A := le_max_left 0 (log A)
         have h0B := le_max_left 0 (log B)
         have h1A := le_max_right 0 (log A)
         have h1B := le_max_right 0 (log B)

         refine max_le (by linarith) ?_

         · rw [← h, log_zero]
           linarith
         · rcases le_total A B with hAB | hAB
           · have hBpos : 0 < B := by linarith
             have h2 : log (A + B) ≤ log (2 * B) := log_le_log h (by linarith)
             rw [log_mul (by norm_num) hBpos.ne'] at h2
             linarith
           · have hApos : 0 < A := by linarith
             have h2 : log (A + B) ≤ log (2 * A) := log_le_log h (by linarith)
             rw [log_mul (by norm_num) hApos.ne'] at h2

    by_cases hne : s.offDiag.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hmin⟩ := s.offDiag.exists_min_image (fun p => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) hne
      rw [Finset.mem_offDiag] at hp

        first
          | exact norm_pos_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 hp.2.2)
          | exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hp.2.2)

      refine ⟨‖p.1 - p.2‖ / 2, half_pos hpos, fun a ha b hb hab => ?_⟩
      have h1 : ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ≤ ‖a - b‖ := hmin (a, b) (Finset.mem_offDiag.2 ⟨ha, hb, hab⟩)

    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun a ha b hb hab =>
        (hne ⟨(a, b), Finset.mem_offDiag.2 ⟨ha, hb, hab⟩⟩).elim⟩
  refine ⟨log 2 + log⁺ (#s * c⁻¹) + #s * log⁺ c⁻¹, fun w => ?_⟩
  have hlog2 : 0 ≤ log 2 := log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hP1 := hpl (‖∑ a ∈ s, (w - a)⁻¹‖)
  have hP2 := hpl ((#s : ℝ) * c⁻¹)
  have hP3 := hpl (c⁻¹)
  by_cases hnear : ∃ a ∈ s, ‖w - a‖ < c
  · obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hwa₀⟩ := hnear
    have key : ∀ a ∈ s.erase a₀, c ≤ ‖w - a‖ := by
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.mem_erase] at ha
      have h1 := hcs a₀ ha₀ a ha.2 (Ne.symm ha.1)
      have h2 : ‖a₀ - a‖ ≤ ‖a₀ - w‖ + ‖w - a‖ := by
        calc ‖a₀ - a‖ = ‖(a₀ - w) + (w - a)‖ := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
          _ ≤ ‖a₀ - w‖ + ‖w - a‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      have h3 : ‖a₀ - w‖ = ‖w - a₀‖ := norm_sub_rev a₀ w
      linarith
    have e1 : ∑ a ∈ s, log⁺ ‖w - a‖⁻¹ = log⁺ ‖w - a₀‖⁻¹ + ∑ a ∈ s.erase a₀, log⁺ ‖w - a‖⁻¹ :=
      (Finset.add_sum_erase s (fun a => log⁺ ‖w - a‖⁻¹) ha₀).symm
    have e2 : ∑ a ∈ s, (w - a)⁻¹ = (w - a₀)⁻¹ + ∑ a ∈ s.erase a₀, (w - a)⁻¹ :=

    have e4 : (#(s.erase a₀) : ℝ) * log⁺ c⁻¹ ≤ (#s : ℝ) * log⁺ c⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hP3

          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro a ha

          gcongr

      have h : (w - a₀)⁻¹ = ∑ a ∈ s, (w - a)⁻¹ - ∑ a ∈ s.erase a₀, (w - a)⁻¹ := by
        rw [e2]

        rw [h]
        exact norm_sub_le _ _
      rw [norm_inv] at h'
      linarith
    have e7 : log⁺ ‖w - a₀‖⁻¹ ≤ log⁺ (‖∑ a ∈ s, (w - a)⁻¹‖ + (#s : ℝ) * c⁻¹) :=

have hα0 : ∀ (c : Fin (n + 3)) (hc : c ≠ i.castSucc.castSucc.succ),
      (c < i.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ∨ i.succ.succ.succ < c) →
        α h₀₂ h₁₃ h c hc = const x := by
    rintro c hc (hc' | hc')
    · exact α_of_lt h₀₂ h₁₃ h c hc'
    · exact α_of_gt h₀₂ h₁₃ h c hc'

      c = i.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc → α h₀₂ h₁₃ h c hc = h₁₃.map := by
    rintro c hc rfl
    exact α_castSucc_castSucc_castSucc h₀₂ h₁₃ h
  have hα2 : ∀ (c : Fin (n + 3)) (hc : c ≠ i.castSucc.castSucc.succ),
      c = i.castSucc.succ.succ → α h₀₂ h₁₃ h c hc = h.map := by
    rintro c hc rfl
    exact α_castSucc_succ_succ h₀₂ h₁₃ h
  have hα3 : ∀ (c : Fin (n + 3)) (hc : c ≠ i.castSucc.castSucc.succ),
      c = i.succ.succ.succ → α h₀₂ h₁₃ h c hc = h₀₂.map := by
    rintro c hc rfl
    exact α_succ_succ_succ h₀₂ h₁₃ h
  have hlt : ∀ (p : Fin (n + 2)) (c : Fin (n + 3)) (hc : c ≠ i.castSucc.castSucc.succ),
      p < i.castSucc.castSucc → stdSimplex.δ p ≫ α h₀₂ h₁₃ h c hc = const x := by
    intro p c hc hp
    by_cases h1 : c = i.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc
    · rw [hα1 c hc h1]
      exact h₁₃.δ_map_of_lt p hp
    by_cases h2 : c = i.castSucc.succ.succ
    · rw [hα2 c hc h2]
      exact h.δ_map_of_lt p hp
    by_cases h3 : c = i.succ.succ.succ
    · rw [hα3 c hc h3]
      exact h₀₂.δ_map_of_lt p hp
    have hc' : c < i.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ∨ i.succ.succ.succ < c := by
      first
      | grind
      | (simp only [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val, Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc,
          ne_eq] at *; omega)
    rw [hα0 c hc hc']
    all_goals first | simp | rfl
  have hgt : ∀ (p : Fin (n + 2)) (c : Fin (n + 3)) (hc : c ≠ i.castSucc.castSucc.succ),
      i.succ.succ < p → stdSimplex.δ p ≫ α h₀₂ h₁₃ h c hc = const x := by
    intro p c hc hp
    by_cases h1 : c = i.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc
    · rw [hα1 c hc h1]
      exact h₁₃.δ_map_of_gt p hp
    by_cases h2 : c = i.castSucc.succ.succ
    · rw [hα2 c hc h2]

    by_cases h3 : c = i.succ.succ.succ
    · rw [hα3 c hc h3]
      exact h₀₂.δ_map_of_gt p hp
    have hc' : c < i.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ∨ i.succ.succ.succ < c := by
      first
      | grind
      | (simp only [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val, Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc,
          ne_eq] at *; omega)
    rw [hα0 c hc hc']
    all_goals first | simp | rfl
  have key : ∀ (j k : Fin (n + 2)) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hj : j.castSucc ≠ i.castSucc.castSucc.succ)
      (hk : k.succ ≠ i.castSucc.castSucc.succ),
      stdSimplex.δ k ≫ α h₀₂ h₁₃ h j.castSucc hj =
        stdSimplex.δ j ≫ α h₀₂ h₁₃ h k.succ hk := by
    intro j k hjk hj hk
    by_cases hj1 : j < i.castSucc.castSucc

        first
        | exact Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mpr hj1
        | grind

        first
        | exact Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr hk1
        | grind

        (j = i.succ.succ ∧ k = i.succ.succ) := by
      first
      | grind
      | (simp only [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val, Fin.le_iff_val_le_val, Fin.val_succ,
          Fin.coe_castSucc, ne_eq, not_lt] at hjk hj hk hj1 hk1 ⊢; omega)
    rcases hcases with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [hα1 _ hj rfl, hα2 _ hk rfl, h₁₃.δ_succ_castSucc_map, h.δ_castSucc_castSucc_map]
    · rw [hα1 _ hj rfl, hα3 _ hk rfl, h₁₃.δ_succ_succ_map, h₀₂.δ_castSucc_castSucc_map]
    · have he : i.succ.succ.castSucc = i.castSucc.succ.succ := by
        first
        | rfl
        | exact Fin.ext (by simp)
        | grind

  first
  | (first | rw [horn.isCompatible_iff] | skip)
    intro a b
    intros
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := a.eq_castSucc_of_ne_last (by grind)
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := b.eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by grind)

      | exact Fin.castSucc_lt_succ_iff.mp ‹_›
      | grind
    simp only [Fin.castPred_castSucc, Fin.pred_succ]
    first
    | exact key j k hjk _ _
    | exact (key j k hjk _ _).symm
  | (first | rw [horn.isCompatible_iff] | skip)
    intro a b
    intros
    first
    | exact key a b ‹_› _ _
    | exact (key a b ‹_› _ _).symm

  have hx_cube (b : Fin n → Bool) (k : Fin n) :
      x k ∈ (cube b).val ↔ b k = true :=
    (hx k _ (cube b).property).trans (mem_cubeBitSlice_iff cube b k)
  have hx_inj : Function.Injective x := by
    intro k l hkl
    by_contra hne
    have h1 := hx_cube (fun i => decide (i = k)) k
    have h2 := hx_cube (fun i => decide (i = k)) l
    rw [hkl] at h1
    have h5 := h2.mp (h1.mpr (by simp))
    simp at h5
    exact hne h5.symm
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.image x, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
    exact hxX k
  · first
      | rw [card_image_of_injective _ hx_inj, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      | simp [card_image_of_injective _ hx_inj]
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨(cube (fun k => decide (x k ∈ t))).val, hSsub (cube _).property, ?_⟩
    ext y
    rw [mem_inter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy, hk⟩
      obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
      rw [hx_cube] at hk
      simpa using hk
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp (ht hy)
      refine ⟨mem_image_of_mem x (mem_univ k), ?_⟩
      rw [hx_cube]
      simpa using hy

have hA : ∀ (c : Char) (cs : List Char),
      Legacy.Iterator.hasNext ⟨String.ofList (c :: cs), 0⟩ = true := by
    intro c cs
    first
      | (simp [Legacy.Iterator.hasNext, Char.utf8Size_pos]; done)
      | (have hpos := Char.utf8Size_pos c
         simp [Legacy.Iterator.hasNext] <;> omega)
      | exact (validFor_mkIterator (String.ofList (c :: cs))).hasNext.mpr (by simp)
      | exact (Legacy.validFor_mkIterator (String.ofList (c :: cs))).hasNext.mpr (by simp)
  have hB : Legacy.Iterator.hasNext ⟨String.ofList [], 0⟩ = false := by
    first
      | (simp [Legacy.Iterator.hasNext]; done)
      | rfl
      | decide
      | exact Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr fun h =>
          absurd ((validFor_mkIterator (String.ofList [])).hasNext.mp h) (by simp)
  have hC : ∀ (c : Char) (cs : List Char),
      Legacy.Iterator.curr ⟨String.ofList (c :: cs), 0⟩ = c := by
    intro c cs
    first
      | exact get_of_valid [] (c :: cs)
      | exact Pos.Raw.get_of_valid [] (c :: cs)
      | (simp [Legacy.Iterator.curr, Pos.Raw.get, utf8GetAux]; done)
      | (simp [Legacy.Iterator.curr, Pos.Raw.get]; done)
      | (simp [Legacy.Iterator.curr]; done)
      | (have h := (validFor_mkIterator (String.ofList (c :: cs))).curr
         rw [toList_ofList] at h
         exact h)
  have hD : ∀ (c : Char) (cs : List Char),
      Legacy.Iterator.next ⟨String.ofList (c :: cs), 0⟩ =
        ⟨String.ofList (c :: cs), (0 : Pos.Raw) + c⟩ := by
    intro c cs
    first
      | exact congrArg (Legacy.Iterator.mk (String.ofList (c :: cs)))
          (congrArg (fun x : Char => (0 : Pos.Raw) + x) (hC c cs))
      | (simp only [Legacy.Iterator.next, Pos.Raw.next]
         have h := hC c cs
         simp only [Legacy.Iterator.curr] at h
         simp only [h])
  have key : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List Char,
      ltb ⟨String.ofList l₁, 0⟩ ⟨String.ofList l₂, 0⟩ = true ↔ l₁ < l₂ := by
    intro l₁
    induction l₁ with
    | nil =>
      intro l₂
      cases l₂ with
      | nil =>
        apply iff_of_false
        · rw [ltb, hB]
          simp
        · first | rintro ⟨⟩ | (simp; done)
      | cons c₂ cs₂ =>
        apply iff_of_true
        · rw [ltb, hA, hB] <;> first | rfl | (simp; done) | decide
        · first | exact List.nil_lt_cons _ _ | exact List.Lex.nil | (simp; done)
    | cons c₁ cs₁ ih =>
      intro l₂
      cases l₂ with
      | nil =>
        apply iff_of_false
        · rw [ltb, hB]
          simp
        · first | rintro ⟨⟩ | (simp; done)
      | cons c₂ cs₂ =>
        rw [ltb, hA, hA, hC, hC, hD, hD]
        by_cases hc : c₁ = c₂
        · rw [if_pos (rfl : true = true), if_pos (rfl : true = true), if_pos hc]
          subst hc
          rw [ltb_cons_addChar, ih]
          first
            | exact List.Lex.cons_iff.symm
            | (simp [List.cons_lt_cons_iff]; done)
            | (refine ⟨fun h => List.Lex.cons h, fun h => ?_⟩
               cases h with
               | cons h => exact h
               | rel h => exact absurd h (lt_irrefl _))
        · rw [if_pos (rfl : true = true), if_pos (rfl : true = true), if_neg hc]
          first
            | (simp [List.cons_lt_cons_iff, hc]; done)
            | (rw [decide_eq_true_iff]
               refine ⟨fun h => List.Lex.rel h, fun h => ?_⟩
               cases h with
               | cons h => exact absurd rfl hc
               | rel h => exact h)
  have h := key s₁.toList s₂.toList
  simp only [ofList_toList] at h
  exact lt_iff_toList_lt.trans h.symm

suffices key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (H : Subgroup G) (hdvd : p ^ n ∣ Nat.card H) (s : Set (Subgroup G))
      (hchain : IsChain (· ≤ ·) s) (hcard : ∀ K ∈ s, Nat.card K ∣ p ^ n)
      (hle : ∀ K ∈ s, K ≤ H),
      ∃ f : Fin (n + 1) ↪o Subgroup G, s ⊆ Set.range f ∧
        ∀ k, Nat.card (f k) = p ^ k.val ∧ f k ≤ H by
    obtain ⟨f, hf1, hf2⟩ := key n ⊤ (by first | rwa [Subgroup.card_top] | simpa using hdvd) s
      hchain hcard (fun _ _ => _root_.le_top)
    exact ⟨f, hf1, fun k => (hf2 k).1⟩
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro H hdvd s hchain hcard hle
    refine ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono (fun _ => ⊥) (fun a b hab => ?_), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exfalso
      have h1 : (a : ℕ) < b := by
        first
          | exact hab
          | exact Fin.lt_def.mp hab
          | exact Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val.mp hab
      have h2 := b.isLt
      omega
    · intro L hL
      have hLbot : L = ⊥ := by
        have h1 := hcard L hL
        rw [pow_zero, Nat.dvd_one] at h1
        first
          | exact Subgroup.eq_bot_of_card_eq L h1
          | exact Subgroup.card_eq_one.mp h1
      exact ⟨0, hLbot.symm⟩
    · intro k
      have hk : (k : ℕ) = 0 := by
        have := k.isLt
        omega
      refine ⟨?_, _root_.bot_le⟩
      show Nat.card (⊥ : Subgroup G) = p ^ (k : ℕ)
      rw [hk, pow_zero, Subgroup.card_bot]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro H hdvd s hchain hcard hle
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀card, hL₀H, hsL₀⟩ : ∃ L₀ : Subgroup G, Nat.card L₀ ∣ p ^ (n + 1) ∧
        L₀ ≤ H ∧ ∀ L ∈ s, L ≤ L₀ := by
      rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hs | hs
      · refine ⟨⊥, ?_, _root_.bot_le, ?_⟩
        · rw [Subgroup.card_bot]
          exact _root_.one_dvd _
        · intro L hL
          rw [hs] at hL
          simp at hL
      · obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀s, hmax⟩ :=
          Set.exists_max_image s (fun L : Subgroup G => Nat.card L) s.toFinite hs
        refine ⟨L₀, hcard L₀ hL₀s, hle L₀ hL₀s, fun L hL => ?_⟩
        rcases eq_or_ne L L₀ with h | h
        · exact h.le
        · rcases hchain hL hL₀s h with h' | h'
          · exact h'
          · exact (Subgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge h' (hmax L hL)).symm.le
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hL₀K, hKH⟩ := exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime_le_le hp hL₀card hdvd hL₀H
    have hs'card : ∀ L ∈ {L | L ∈ s ∧ L ≠ K}, Nat.card L ∣ p ^ n := by
      rintro L ⟨hLs, hLK⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hLj⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp).mp (hcard L hLs)
      have hjn : j ≤ n := by
        by_contra hjn
        apply hLK
        apply Subgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge ((hsL₀ L hLs).trans hL₀K)
        rw [hK, hLj]
        exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp.pos (by omega)
      rw [hLj]
      exact _root_.pow_dvd_pow p hjn
    obtain ⟨f', hf's, hf'⟩ := ih K (by rw [hK]; exact _root_.pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n))
      {L | L ∈ s ∧ L ≠ K} (hchain.mono (fun L hL => hL.1)) hs'card
      (fun L hL => (hsL₀ L hL.1).trans hL₀K)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → Subgroup G,
        ∀ k, g k = if h : (k : ℕ) < n + 1 then f' ⟨(k : ℕ), h⟩ else K :=
      ⟨fun k => if h : (k : ℕ) < n + 1 then f' ⟨(k : ℕ), h⟩ else K, fun k => rfl⟩
    have hgK : ∀ k, g k ≤ K := by
      intro k
      rw [hg]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact (hf' _).2
      · exact le_rfl
    have hgcard : ∀ k : Fin (n + 1 + 1), Nat.card (g k) = p ^ (k : ℕ) := by
      intro k
      rw [hg]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact (hf' _).1
      · rw [hK]
        have := k.isLt
        congr 1
        omega
    have hgmono : Monotone g := by
      intro a b hab
      have hab' : (a : ℕ) ≤ b := by
        first
          | exact hab
          | exact Fin.le_def.mp hab
          | exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hab
      by_cases hb : (b : ℕ) < n + 1
      · have ha : (a : ℕ) < n + 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hab' hb
        rw [hg a, hg b, dif_pos ha, dif_pos hb]
        first
          | exact f'.monotone (show (⟨(a : ℕ), ha⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) ≤ ⟨(b : ℕ), hb⟩ from hab')
          | exact f'.monotone (Fin.le_def.mpr hab')
          | exact f'.le_iff_le.mpr (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr hab')
      · rw [hg b, dif_neg hb]
        exact hgK a
    have hginj : Function.Injective g := by
      intro a b hab
      have h1 : p ^ (a : ℕ) = p ^ (b : ℕ) := by
        rw [← hgcard a, ← hgcard b, hab]
      first
        | exact Fin.ext (Nat.pow_right_injective hp.two_le h1)
        | exact Fin.ext (Nat.pow_right_injective (Nat.Prime.two_le hp) h1)
    refine ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono g (hgmono.strictMono_of_injective hginj), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro L hL
      rcases eq_or_ne L K with hLK | hLK
      · have hlast : ¬ ((Fin.last (n + 1) : ℕ) < n + 1) := by
          first
            | simp
            | exact lt_irrefl _
        refine ⟨Fin.last (n + 1), ?_⟩
        show g (Fin.last (n + 1)) = L
        rw [hLK, hg, dif_neg hlast]
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hf's (show L ∈ {L | L ∈ s ∧ L ≠ K} from ⟨hL, hLK⟩)
        subst hj
        refine ⟨⟨(j : ℕ), by have := j.isLt; omega⟩, ?_⟩
        show g ⟨(j : ℕ), _⟩ = f' j
        first
          | (rw [hg, dif_pos j.isLt]; done)
          | (rw [hg, dif_pos j.isLt]; rfl)
          | (simp [hg]; done)
          | (rw [hg]; simp)
    · intro k
      first
        | exact ⟨hgcard k, (hgK k).trans hKH⟩
        | (simp only [OrderEmbedding.coe_ofStrictMono]; exact ⟨hgcard k, (hgK k).trans hKH⟩)

have hker' : ∀ x, A *ᵥ x = 0 → C *ᵥ x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    intro x h1 h2
    first
      | exact hker x h1 h2
      | exact hker x (by simpa using h1) (by simpa using h2)
  have unit_of : ∀ M : Matrix l l R, (∀ x, M *ᵥ x = 0 → x = 0) → IsUnit M := by
    intro M hM
    first
      | rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
        intro hdet
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hMv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
        exact hv (hM v hMv)
      | rw [← Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit]
        intro a b hab
        have hab' := hM (a - b) (by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hab, sub_self])
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hab'
  have base : ∀ A' : Matrix l l R, (∀ x, A' *ᵥ x = 0 → x = 0) →
      ∃ X : Matrix l l R, X.IsSymm ∧ IsUnit (A' + X * C) := by
    intro A' hA'
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · first
        | exact Matrix.isSymm_zero
        | exact Matrix.transpose_zero
    · rw [zero_mul, add_zero]
      exact unit_of A' hA'
  have step : ∀ A' : Matrix l l R, (∀ x, A' *ᵥ x = 0 → C *ᵥ x = 0 → x = 0) →
      A'ᵀ * C = Cᵀ * A' → ∀ v, A' *ᵥ v = 0 → v ≠ 0 →
      ∃ E : Matrix l l R, E.IsSymm ∧ (∀ w, (A' + E * C) *ᵥ w = 0 → A' *ᵥ w = 0) ∧
        (A' + E * C) *ᵥ v ≠ 0 := by
    intro A' h1 h2 v hv0 hvne
    have hCv : C *ᵥ v ≠ 0 := fun h => hvne (h1 v hv0 h)
    obtain ⟨i, hsi⟩ : ∃ i, (C *ᵥ v) i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hCv (funext hcon)
    have hs : (C *ᵥ v) ᵥ* A' = 0 := by
      rw [← Matrix.vecMul_transpose, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul, ← h2, ← Matrix.vecMul_vecMul,
        Matrix.vecMul_transpose, hv0, Matrix.zero_vecMul]
    have hz : ∀ (y : l → R) (j : l), j ≠ i →
        (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)) *ᵥ y) j = 0 := by
      intro y j hj
      first
        | rw [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, zero_mul]
        | simp [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.single_apply, hj]
    have hzi : ∀ y : l → R, (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)) *ᵥ y) i = y i := by
      intro y
      first
        | rw [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.single_eq_same, one_mul]
        | simp [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
    have hdot : ∀ y : l → R, (C *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)) *ᵥ y) =
        (C *ᵥ v) i * y i := by
      intro y
      have hsum : ∀ j, j ≠ i →
          (C *ᵥ v) j * (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)) *ᵥ y) j = 0 := by
        intro j hj
        rw [hz y j hj, mul_zero]
      show ∑ j, (C *ᵥ v) j * (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)) *ᵥ y) j = (C *ᵥ v) i * y i
      rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single i hsum, hzi]
    refine ⟨Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · first
        | exact Matrix.isSymm_diagonal _
        | exact Matrix.diagonal_transpose _
    · intro w hw
      rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at hw
      have h0 : (C *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A' *ᵥ w) = 0 := by
        first
          | rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hs]
            simp
          | rw [dotProduct_mulVec, hs]
            simp
      have h3 : (C *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)) *ᵥ (C *ᵥ w)) = 0 := by
        have h4 := congrArg (fun z => (C *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ z) hw
        first
          | simpa [h0] using h4
          | simp only [dotProduct_add, h0, zero_add, dotProduct_zero] at h4
            exact h4
      rw [hdot] at h3
      have hyi : (C *ᵥ w) i = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left hsi
      have hz0 : Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)) *ᵥ (C *ᵥ w) = 0 := by
        funext j
        show (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : R)) *ᵥ (C *ᵥ w)) j = 0
        by_cases hj : j = i
        · rw [hj, hzi]
          exact hyi
        · exact hz _ j hj
      rw [hz0, add_zero] at hw
      exact hw
    · intro h
      rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hv0, zero_add] at h
      have h5 := congrFun h i
      rw [hzi] at h5
      exact hsi h5
  have main : ∀ (k : ℕ) (A' : Matrix l l R), (∀ x, A' *ᵥ x = 0 → C *ᵥ x = 0 → x = 0) →
      A'ᵀ * C = Cᵀ * A' →
      Module.finrank R (LinearMap.ker A'.mulVecLin) ≤ k →
      ∃ X : Matrix l l R, X.IsSymm ∧ IsUnit (A' + X * C) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro A' h1 h2 h3
      apply base
      intro x hx
      by_contra hx0
      have hlt : (⊥ : Submodule R (l → R)) < LinearMap.ker A'.mulVecLin := by
        rw [SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists]
        refine ⟨bot_le, x, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
          exact hx
        · rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
          exact hx0
      have h6 : Module.finrank R (⊥ : Submodule R (l → R)) <
          Module.finrank R (LinearMap.ker A'.mulVecLin) := by
        first
          | exact Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt
          | exact Submodule.finrank_strictMono hlt
      have h7 : Module.finrank R (⊥ : Submodule R (l → R)) = 0 := by simp
      omega
    | succ k ih =>
      intro A' h1 h2 h3
      by_cases hinj : ∀ x, A' *ᵥ x = 0 → x = 0
      · exact base A' hinj
      · push_neg at hinj
        obtain ⟨v, hv0, hvne⟩ := hinj
        obtain ⟨E, hEs, hE1, hE2⟩ := step A' h1 h2 v hv0 hvne
        have h1' : ∀ x, (A' + E * C) *ᵥ x = 0 → C *ᵥ x = 0 → x = 0 :=
          fun x hx hCx => h1 x (hE1 x hx) hCx
        have h2' : (A' + E * C)ᵀ * C = Cᵀ * (A' + E * C) := by
          rw [Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_mul, hEs.eq, Matrix.add_mul,
            Matrix.mul_add, h2, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        have hlt : LinearMap.ker (A' + E * C).mulVecLin < LinearMap.ker A'.mulVecLin := by
          rw [SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists]
          refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, v, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] at hx ⊢
            exact hE1 x hx
          · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
            exact hv0
          · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
            exact hE2
        have h6 : Module.finrank R (LinearMap.ker (A' + E * C).mulVecLin) <
            Module.finrank R (LinearMap.ker A'.mulVecLin) := by
          first
            | exact Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt
            | exact Submodule.finrank_strictMono hlt
        obtain ⟨X, hXs, hXu⟩ := ih (A' + E * C) h1' h2' (by omega)
        refine ⟨E + X, ?_, ?_⟩
        · first
            | exact hEs.add hXs
            | exact Matrix.IsSymm.add hEs hXs
            | show (E + X)ᵀ = E + X
              rw [Matrix.transpose_add, hEs.eq, hXs.eq]
        · rw [add_mul, ← add_assoc]
          exact hXu
  exact main _ A hker' hsymm le_rfl

have hmAt : ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ, Meromorphic F → ∀ x : ℂ, MeromorphicAt F x := by
    intro F hF x
    first
      | exact hF x
      | exact hF.meromorphicAt
      | exact hF.meromorphicOn x (Set.mem_univ x)
  have hmInv : ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ, Meromorphic F → Meromorphic (fun z => (F z)⁻¹) := by
    intro F hF
    first
      | fun_prop
      | exact hF.inv
      | exact fun x => (hmAt F hF x).inv
      | exact fun x _ => (hmAt F hF x).inv
  have hmAdd : ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ, Meromorphic F → ∀ t : ℂ, Meromorphic (fun z => t + F z) := by
    intro F hF t
    first
      | fun_prop
      | exact fun x => (MeromorphicAt.const t x).add (hmAt F hF x)
      | exact fun x _ => (MeromorphicAt.const t x).add (hmAt F hF x)
      | exact fun x => analyticAt_const.meromorphicAt.add (hmAt F hF x)
  have hshift : ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ, Meromorphic F → ∀ t : ℂ,
      (characteristic F ⊤ - characteristic (fun z => t + F z) ⊤) =O[atTop] (1 : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro F hF t
    have h := isBigO_characteristic_sub_characteristic_shift (a₀ := -t) hF
    have hfun : (fun z => F z - -t) = (fun z => t + F z) := by
      funext z
      ring
    first
      | (rw [hfun] at h; exact h)
      | (convert h using 3; funext z; ring)
  have key : ∀ u : ℂ → ℂ, Meromorphic u → ∀ α γ β : ℂ,
      (characteristic u ⊤ - characteristic (fun z => α + (γ + (β + u z)⁻¹)⁻¹) ⊤)
        =O[atTop] (1 : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro u hu α γ β
    have hu1 : Meromorphic (fun z => β + u z) := hmAdd u hu β
    have hu2 : Meromorphic (fun z => (β + u z)⁻¹) := hmInv _ hu1
    have hu3 : Meromorphic (fun z => γ + (β + u z)⁻¹) := hmAdd _ hu2 γ
    have hu4 : Meromorphic (fun z => (γ + (β + u z)⁻¹)⁻¹) := hmInv _ hu3
    have e1 := hshift u hu β
    have e2 := isBigO_characteristic_sub_characteristic_inv hu1

have hderiv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ (k + 1) f (x + t • y) →
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (x + s • y) (fun _ ↦ y))
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) t := by
    intro k t ht
    have hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f) (x + t • y) := by
      apply ht.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
      norm_cast
      exact lt_add_one k
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z (fun _ ↦ y)) (x + t • y) :=
      hf'.continuousMultilinear_apply_const _
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s : ℝ ↦ x + s • y) t := by fun_prop
    have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (x + s • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) t :=
      h1.comp t h2
    rw [← ht.deriv_fderiv_add_smul]
    exact h3.hasDerivAt
  have hcont : ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ (k + 1) f (x + t • y)) →
      ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y))
        (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
    intro k hk t ht
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at ht
    have h0 : ContDiffAt ℝ 0 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f) (x + t • y) :=
      (hk t ht).iteratedFDeriv_right (by first | simp | (norm_cast; simp))
    have h1 : ContinuousAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f) (x + t • y) := h0.continuousAt
    have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ x + s • y) t := by fun_prop
    have h3 : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f (x + s • y)) t :=
      h1.comp_of_eq h2 rfl
    have h4 : ContinuousAt
        (fun s : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f (x + s • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) t := by
      first
        | exact h3.eval_const (fun _ ↦ y)
        | exact (continuous_eval_const (fun _ ↦ y)).continuousAt.comp h3
        | exact (ContinuousMultilinearMap.continuous_eval_const (fun _ ↦ y)).continuousAt.comp h3
        | fun_prop
    exact h4.continuousWithinAt
  revert hf
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro hf
    have hI := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (fun t ht ↦ hderiv 0 t (hf t (by rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at ht)))
      (hcont 0 hf).intervalIntegrable
    simp only [pow_zero, one_smul]
    rw [hI]
    simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, zero_add, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, inv_one,
      one_smul, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply, zero_smul, add_zero]
    abel
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hf
    have hf' : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) := fun t ht ↦
      (hf t ht).of_le (by first | (norm_cast; omega) | simp | exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ (n + 1))
    have hu : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ (1 - t) ^ (n + 1)) (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) t := by
      intro t _
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ 1 - t) (-1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub 1
      have h2 := h1.pow (n + 1)
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h2
      convert h2 using 1 <;> first | ring | rfl | (funext s; simp)
    have hv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y))
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1 + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at ht
      exact hderiv (n + 1) t (hf t ht)
    have hcu : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ (1 - t) ^ (n + 1)) := by fun_prop
    have hcu' : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ -(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) := by fun_prop
    have hcv : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y))
        (Set.uIcc 0 1) := hcont n hf'
    have hcv' : ContinuousOn
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1 + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y))
        (Set.uIcc 0 1) := hcont (n + 1) hf
    have hint1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ (1 - t) ^ (n + 1) •
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1 + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hcu.continuousOn.smul hcv').intervalIntegrable
    have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) •
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hcu'.continuousOn.smul hcv).intervalIntegrable
    have hIBP0 : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) ^ (n + 1) •
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1 + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)
        = ((1 : ℝ) - 1) ^ (n + 1) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + (1 : ℝ) • y) (fun _ ↦ y)
          - ((1 : ℝ) - 0) ^ (n + 1) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + (0 : ℝ) • y) (fun _ ↦ y)
          - ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) •
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y) := by
      have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (fun t ht ↦ (hu t ht).smul (hv t ht)) (hint1.add hint2)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hint1 hint2] at hFTC
      exact eq_sub_of_add_eq hFTC
    have e1 : ((1 : ℝ) - 1) ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by simp
    have e2 : ((1 : ℝ) - 0) ^ (n + 1) = 1 := by simp
    have e3 : x + (0 : ℝ) • y = x := by simp
    have e4 : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) •
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)
        = -(((n : ℝ) + 1) • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) ^ n •
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) := by
      simp only [neg_smul, mul_smul, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
    rw [e1, e2, zero_smul, one_smul, e3, e4] at hIBP0
    have hb : (((n + 1)! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((n : ℝ) + 1) = ((n ! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      have h2 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add_one, mul_inv, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, one_mul]
    rw [ih hf', Finset.sum_range_succ _ (n + 1), add_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [hIBP0, smul_sub, smul_sub, smul_zero, smul_neg, smul_smul, hb]
    abel
