have comp_lem : ∀ {A B : Scheme.{u}} (φ : A ⟶ B) (K : Type u) [Field K] (a : A)
      (ψ : A.residueField a ⟶ CommRingCat.of K),
      (SpecToEquivOfField K A).symm ⟨a, ψ⟩ ≫ φ =
        (SpecToEquivOfField K B).symm ⟨φ a, φ.residueFieldMap a ≫ ψ⟩ := by
    intro A B φ K _ a ψ
    first
      | (change (Spec.map ψ ≫ A.fromSpecResidueField a) ≫ φ = Spec.map (φ.residueFieldMap a ≫ ψ) ≫ B.fromSpecResidueField (φ a); rw [Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.Spec_map_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField])
      | (simp only [SpecToEquivOfField_symm_apply, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.Spec_map_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField]; done)
      | (simp [SpecToEquivOfField, Scheme.Hom.Spec_map_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField]; done)
  have h21 : (∀ (K : Type u) [Field K], Function.Injective (fun g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ X ↦ g ≫ f)) →
      UniversallyInjective f := by
    intro H
    constructor
    intro X' Y' i₁ i₂ f' hsq
    have H' : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K],
        Function.Injective (fun g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ X' ↦ g ≫ f') := by
      intro K _ g₁ g₂ e
      dsimp only at e
      apply hsq.hom_ext
      · exact e
      · apply H K
        have := congrArg (· ≫ i₂) e
        simp only [Category.assoc] at this ⊢
        rw [← hsq.w]
        exact this
    intro x₁ x₂ hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback x₁ x₂ hx
    have key : (pullback f' f').fromSpecResidueField z ≫ pullback.fst f' f' =
        (pullback f' f').fromSpecResidueField z ≫ pullback.snd f' f' :=
      H' ((pullback f' f').residueField z) (by
        dsimp only
        rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullback.condition])
    have hs : (pullback f' f').fromSpecResidueField z
        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ((pullback f' f').residueField z)) = z := by
      first
        | exact Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply z _
        | exact Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply _ _
        | simp
    rw [← hz₁, ← hz₂, ← hs, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, key, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have h42 : Surjective (pullback.diagonal f) →
      ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K], Function.Injective (fun g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ X ↦ g ≫ f) := by
    intro hΔ K _ g₁ g₂ e
    dsimp only at e
    obtain ⟨⟨q, χ⟩, hq⟩ := (SpecToEquivOfField K (pullback f f)).symm.surjective
      (pullback.lift g₁ g₂ e)
    obtain ⟨x₀, rfl⟩ := hΔ q
    have h1 : IsIso ((pullback.diagonal f ≫ pullback.fst f f).residueFieldMap x₀) := by
      rw [pullback.diagonal_fst]
      first
        | infer_instance
        | (rw [Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_id]; infer_instance)
        | (simp only [Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_id]; infer_instance)
    first
      | rw [Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_comp] at h1
      | rw [Scheme.residueFieldMap_comp] at h1
      | simp only [Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_comp] at h1
    have hmono : Mono ((pullback.diagonal f).residueFieldMap x₀) := by
      first
        | exact ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective _ ((pullback.diagonal f).residueFieldMap x₀).hom.injective
        | exact (CommRingCat.mono_iff_injective _).2 ((pullback.diagonal f).residueFieldMap x₀).hom.injective
    have hsplit : IsSplitEpi ((pullback.diagonal f).residueFieldMap x₀) :=
      IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨inv ((pullback.fst f f).residueFieldMap (pullback.diagonal f x₀) ≫
        (pullback.diagonal f).residueFieldMap x₀) ≫
          (pullback.fst f f).residueFieldMap (pullback.diagonal f x₀),
        by rw [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id]⟩
    have hiso : IsIso ((pullback.diagonal f).residueFieldMap x₀) :=
      isIso_of_mono_of_isSplitEpi _
    have hg : (SpecToEquivOfField K X).symm
        ⟨x₀, inv ((pullback.diagonal f).residueFieldMap x₀) ≫ χ⟩ ≫ pullback.diagonal f =
        pullback.lift g₁ g₂ e := by
      rw [comp_lem, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, hq]
    calc g₁ = pullback.lift g₁ g₂ e ≫ pullback.fst f f := (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _).symm
      _ = pullback.lift g₁ g₂ e ≫ pullback.snd f f := by
        rw [← hg, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullback.diagonal_fst, pullback.diagonal_snd]
      _ = g₂ := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 4 := UniversallyInjective.iff_diagonal f
  tfae_have 2 → 1 := h21
  tfae_have 4 → 2 := h42
  tfae_have 3 → 2 := by
    rintro ⟨hinj, hpi⟩ K _ g₁ g₂ e
    dsimp only at e
    obtain ⟨⟨x₁, φ₁⟩, rfl⟩ := (SpecToEquivOfField K X).symm.surjective g₁
    obtain ⟨⟨x₂, φ₂⟩, rfl⟩ := (SpecToEquivOfField K X).symm.surjective g₂
    have e1 := (SpecToEquivOfField K Y).symm.injective
      ((comp_lem f K x₁ φ₁).symm.trans (e.trans (comp_lem f K x₂ φ₂)))
    obtain ⟨hx, hφ⟩ := Sigma.mk.inj e1
    have hx' : x₁ = x₂ := hinj hx
    subst x₂
    have hφ' : f.residueFieldMap x₁ ≫ φ₁ = f.residueFieldMap x₁ ≫ φ₂ := eq_of_heq hφ
    have key : φ₁ = φ₂ := by
      letI := (f.residueFieldMap x₁).hom.toAlgebra
      haveI : IsPurelyInseparable (Y.residueField (f x₁)) (X.residueField x₁) := hpi x₁
      ext1
      first
        | exact IsPurelyInseparable.injective_comp_algebraMap _ _ K (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hφ')
        | exact IsPurelyInseparable.injective_comp_algebraMap K (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hφ')
        | exact IsPurelyInseparable.injective_comp_algebraMap (Y.residueField (f x₁)) (X.residueField x₁) K (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hφ')
    rw [key]
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := by
    intro H
    haveI := h21 H
    refine ⟨Scheme.Hom.injective f, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    letI := (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    suffices IsPurelyInseparable (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) from this
    have main : Function.Injective fun φ : X.residueField x →+* AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField x) ↦
        φ.comp (algebraMap (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)) := by
      intro φ₁ φ₂ hφ
      have h0 : f.residueFieldMap x ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ₁ =
          f.residueFieldMap x ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ₂ := by
        ext1
        exact hφ
      have h2 : (SpecToEquivOfField (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField x)) X).symm
          ⟨x, CommRingCat.ofHom φ₁⟩ =
          (SpecToEquivOfField (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField x)) X).symm
          ⟨x, CommRingCat.ofHom φ₂⟩ := by
        apply H (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField x))
        dsimp only
        rw [comp_lem, comp_lem, h0]
      have h3 := Sigma.mk.inj ((SpecToEquivOfField _ X).symm.injective h2)
      exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (eq_of_heq h3.2)
    first
      | exact IsPurelyInseparable.of_injective_comp_algebraMap _ _ (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField x)) main
      | exact IsPurelyInseparable.of_injective_comp_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField x)) main
      | exact IsPurelyInseparable.of_injective_comp_algebraMap (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField x)) main
  tfae_finish

      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, Nat.sub_self, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_div, Nat.zero_add]

        turanNumber (m + r) r = ((m + r) ^ 2 - ((m + r) % r) ^ 2) * (r - 1) / (2 * r) +
          ((m + r) % r).choose 2 := by
      intro m hm

      have hc : r.choose 2 * 2 = r * (r - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.choose_two_right, Nat.div_two_mul_two_of_even (Nat.even_mul_pred_self r)]

        Nat.mul_add _ _ _
      have g1 : 2 * m * r * (r - 1) = 2 * (r * (m * (r - 1))) := by

    intro k l hkl
    have h1 := hx_cube (fun i => decide (i = k)) k

  · intro y hy

  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨(cube (fun k => decide (x k ∈ t))).val, hSsub (cube _).property, ?_⟩
    ext y

    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy, hk⟩

classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hO.bound
  obtain ⟨N, hCN⟩ := exists_nat_gt C
  by_contra hinf
  have hinf' : D.support.Infinite := hinf
  obtain ⟨t, htsub, htcard⟩ : ∃ t : Finset E, (t : Set E) ⊆ D.support ∧ t.card = N := by
    first
      | exact hinf'.exists_subset_card_eq N
      | exact Set.Infinite.exists_subset_card_eq hinf' N
  have happ : ∀ (s : Finset E) (w : E),
      (∑ z ∈ s, single z (1 : ℤ) : locallyFinsupp E ℤ) w
        = ∑ z ∈ s, (single z (1 : ℤ) : locallyFinsupp E ℤ) w := by
    intro s w
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · first
        | (simp; done)
        | (simp only [Finset.sum_empty] <;> rfl)
        | rfl
    · intro a s ha ih
      first
        | (rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, coe_add, Pi.add_apply, ih]; done)
        | (rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, ← ih] <;> rfl)
        | (simp [Finset.sum_insert ha, ih]; done)

    intro w
    have h0 : 0 ≤ D w := by
      first
        | exact h w
        | simpa using h w
    show (∑ z ∈ t, single z (1 : ℤ) : locallyFinsupp E ℤ) w ≤ D w
    rw [happ t w]
    have hmemD : w ∈ t → 1 ≤ D w := by
      intro hw
      have h1 : D w ≠ 0 := by
        have hmem := htsub (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hw)
        first
          | exact hmem
          | simpa using hmem
      omega
    first
      | (simp only [single_apply, Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
         split_ifs with hw
         · exact hmemD hw
         · exact h0)
      | (simp only [single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
         first
           | rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
           | rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
         split_ifs with hw
         · exact hmemD hw
         · exact h0)
      | (simp only [single_apply]
         first
           | rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
           | rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
         split_ifs with hw
         · exact hmemD hw
         · exact h0)
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ : ∃ R₀ : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ t, ‖z‖ ≤ R₀ := by
    refine ⟨∑ z ∈ t, ‖z‖, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => norm_nonneg i) hz
  have hEq : ∀ᶠ r in atTop, logCounting (∑ z ∈ t, single z (1 : ℤ) : locallyFinsupp E ℤ) r
      = (N : ℝ) * Real.log r - ∑ z ∈ t, Real.log ‖z‖ := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop R₀] with r hr
    have hterm : ∀ z ∈ t, logCounting (single z (1 : ℤ)) r = Real.log r - Real.log ‖z‖ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [logCounting_single_eq_log_sub_const ((hR₀ z hz).trans hr)]
      simp
    first
      | (rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
          Finset.sum_const, htcard, nsmul_eq_mul]; done)
      | (rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]

  have hFinal : ∀ᶠ r in atTop, ((N : ℝ) - C) * Real.log r ≤ ∑ z ∈ t, Real.log ‖z‖ := by
    filter_upwards [hC, hEq, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with r hr1 hr2 hr3
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log r := Real.log_nonneg hr3
    have h4 := logCounting_le hle hr3
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hr1
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hlog] at hr1
    have h5 : logCounting D r ≤ C * Real.log r := le_trans (le_abs_self _) hr1
    have hexp : ((N : ℝ) - C) * Real.log r = (N : ℝ) * Real.log r - C * Real.log r := by ring
    rw [hexp]
    linarith
  have hTendsto : Tendsto (fun r ↦ ((N : ℝ) - C) * Real.log r) atTop atTop := by
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) - C := by linarith

      | exact (Filter.tendsto_const_mul_atTop_of_pos hpos).mpr Real.tendsto_log_atTop
      | exact Real.tendsto_log_atTop.const_mul_atTop hpos
  obtain ⟨r, hr₁, hr₂⟩ :=
    (hFinal.and (hTendsto.eventually_gt_atTop (∑ z ∈ t, Real.log ‖z‖))).exists
  have hr₂' : ∑ z ∈ t, Real.log ‖z‖ < ((N : ℝ) - C) * Real.log r := hr₂
  linarith

classical
  have hr₀ : (0 : ℝ) < r := by linarith
  have hρ₀ : (0 : ℝ) < ρ := by linarith
  have habsρ : |ρ| = ρ := abs_of_pos hρ₀
  have habsr : |r| = r := abs_of_pos hr₀
  have hD' : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ D z := fun z => by
    first
      | exact hD z
      | simpa using hD z
  have hpos : ∀ (s : ℝ) (z : ℂ), 0 ≤ D.toClosedBall s z := by
    intro s z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |s|
    · rw [toClosedBall_eval_within D hz]
      exact hD' z
    · exact (apply_eq_zero_of_notMem (D.toClosedBall s) hz).symm.le
  have hfin : (D.toClosedBall r).support.Finite :=
    (D.toClosedBall r).finiteSupport (isCompact_closedBall 0 |r|)
  have hmem : ∀ z : ℂ, D.toClosedBall r z ≠ 0 → z ∈ hfin.toFinset := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    first
      | exact hz
      | exact Function.mem_support.mpr hz
      | simpa using hz
  have hmemρ : ∀ z : ℂ, D.toClosedBall ρ z ≠ 0 → z ∈ hfin.toFinset := by
    intro z hz
    have hzρ : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |ρ| := by
      by_contra hc
      exact hz (apply_eq_zero_of_notMem (D.toClosedBall ρ) hc)
    have hzr : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |r| := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hzρ ⊢
      rw [habsρ] at hzρ
      rw [habsr]
      linarith
    apply hmem
    rw [toClosedBall_eval_within D hzr]
    rwa [toClosedBall_eval_within D hzρ] at hz
  have hL : (∑ᶠ z, (D.toClosedBall ρ z : ℝ)) = ∑ z ∈ hfin.toFinset, (D.toClosedBall ρ z : ℝ) := by
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro z hz
    rw [Finset.mem_coe]
    apply hmemρ
    intro h
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hz
    exact hz (by simp [h])
  have hR : D.logCounting r
      = (∑ z ∈ hfin.toFinset, (D.toClosedBall r z : ℝ) * Real.log (r * ‖z‖⁻¹))
        + (D 0 : ℝ) * Real.log r := by
    simp only [logCounting, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
    congr 1
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro z hz
    rw [Finset.mem_coe]
    apply hmem
    intro h
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hz
    exact hz (by simp [h])
  rw [hL, hR, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hlogρ : Real.log (r / ρ) ≤ Real.log r := by
    rw [Real.log_div hr₀.ne' hρ₀.ne']
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hρ]
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D 0 : ℝ) * Real.log r :=
    mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hD' 0) (Real.log_nonneg (by linarith))
  have key : ∀ z ∈ hfin.toFinset, (D.toClosedBall ρ z : ℝ) * Real.log (r / ρ)
      ≤ (D.toClosedBall r z : ℝ) * Real.log (r * ‖z‖⁻¹)
        + (if z = 0 then (D 0 : ℝ) * Real.log r else 0) := by
    intro z _
    by_cases hz0 : z = 0
    · subst hz0
      have h1 : D.toClosedBall ρ 0 = D 0 := by
        apply toClosedBall_eval_within D
        first
          | exact Metric.mem_closedBall_self (abs_nonneg ρ)
          | simp
      have h3 : (D.toClosedBall r 0 : ℝ) * Real.log (r * ‖(0 : ℂ)‖⁻¹) = 0 := by simp
      rw [h1, h3, zero_add]
      first
        | rw [if_pos rfl]
        | rw [if_pos (rfl : (0 : ℂ) = 0)]
        | simp only [↓reduceIte]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogρ (by exact_mod_cast hD' 0)
    · rw [if_neg hz0, add_zero]
      have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz0
      by_cases hzρ : ‖z‖ ≤ ρ
      · have hmρ : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |ρ| := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, habsρ]
          exact hzρ
        have hmr : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |r| := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, habsr]
          linarith
        rw [toClosedBall_eval_within D hmρ, toClosedBall_eval_within D hmr]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by exact_mod_cast hD' z)
        rw [Real.log_div hr₀.ne' hρ₀.ne', Real.log_mul hr₀.ne' (inv_ne_zero hzpos.ne'),
          Real.log_inv]
        have hl : Real.log ‖z‖ ≤ Real.log ρ := by
          first
            | exact Real.log_le_log hzpos hzρ
            | exact (Real.log_le_log_iff hzpos hρ₀).mpr hzρ
        linarith
      · have hnρ : z ∉ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |ρ| := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, habsρ]
          exact hzρ
        rw [apply_eq_zero_of_notMem (D.toClosedBall ρ) hnρ, Int.cast_zero, zero_mul]
        by_cases hzr : ‖z‖ ≤ r
        · refine mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpos r z) ?_
          rw [Real.log_mul hr₀.ne' (inv_ne_zero hzpos.ne'), Real.log_inv]
          have hl : Real.log ‖z‖ ≤ Real.log r := by
            first
              | exact Real.log_le_log hzpos hzr
              | exact (Real.log_le_log_iff hzpos hr₀).mpr hzr
          linarith
        · have hnr : z ∉ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) |r| := by
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, habsr]
            exact hzr
          have h0 : D.toClosedBall r z = 0 := apply_eq_zero_of_notMem (D.toClosedBall r) hnr
          rw [h0]
          simp
  have hsum : ∑ z ∈ hfin.toFinset, (if z = 0 then (D 0 : ℝ) * Real.log r else 0)

    first

  have hnb : ∀ α : H.root, genWeightSpace L (⇑α.1 : H → K) ≠ ⊥ :=
    fun α ↦ α.1.genWeightSpace_ne_bot
  have hconv : ∀ α β γ : H.root,
      (rootSystem H).root γ = (rootSystem H).root α + (rootSystem H).root β →
      (⇑γ.1 : H → K) = ⇑α.1 + ⇑β.1 := by
    intro α β γ h
    ext x
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h x

    | exact this
    | simpa using this
    | simpa [rootSystem_root_apply] using this
  have hconv' : ∀ α β : H.root,
      (rootSystem H).root β = -(rootSystem H).root α → (⇑β.1 : H → K) = -⇑α.1 := by
    intro α β h
    ext x
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
    first
    | exact this
    | simpa using this
    | simpa [rootSystem_root_apply] using this
  have hrefl : ∀ α : H.root,
      (⇑((rootSystem H).reflectionPerm α α).1 : H → K) = -⇑α.1 := by
    intro α
    apply hconv'
    first
    | rw [RootPairing.root_reflectionPerm, RootPairing.reflection_apply_self]
    | simp [RootPairing.root_reflectionPerm]
    | (rw [RootPairing.root_reflectionPerm]; simp)
    | simp
  have hnb' : ∀ α : H.root, genWeightSpace L (-⇑α.1 : H → K) ≠ ⊥ := fun α ↦ by
    first
    | exact (-α.1).genWeightSpace_ne_bot
    | (rw [← hrefl α]; exact hnb _)
  have hsimple : ∀ α : H.root, α ∈ b.support →
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) := by
    intro α hα
    exact ⟨hspan _ (hnz α) (e ⟨α, hα⟩) (e_mem ⟨α, hα⟩) (ef_sl2 ⟨α, hα⟩).e_ne_zero
        (e_mem_S ⟨α, hα⟩),
      hspan _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr (hnz α)) (f ⟨α, hα⟩) (f_mem ⟨α, hα⟩)
        (ef_sl2 ⟨α, hα⟩).f_ne_zero (f_mem_S ⟨α, hα⟩)⟩
  have hadd : ∀ α β γ : H.root,
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) → β ∈ b.support →
      (⇑γ.1 : H → K) = ⇑α.1 + ⇑β.1 →
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑γ.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑γ.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) := by
    intro α β γ hα hβ hγ
    refine ⟨hstep (⇑β.1) (⇑α.1) (⇑γ.1) (hnb α) (hnz β) (hnz γ)
        (by rw [hγ]; exact add_comm _ _) (e ⟨β, hβ⟩) (e_mem ⟨β, hβ⟩)
        (ef_sl2 ⟨β, hβ⟩).e_ne_zero (e_mem_S ⟨β, hβ⟩) hα.1 (hnb γ),
      hstep (-⇑β.1) (-⇑α.1) (-⇑γ.1) (hnb' α) (neg_ne_zero.mpr (hnz β))
        (neg_ne_zero.mpr (hnz γ)) (by rw [hγ, neg_add]; exact add_comm _ _) (f ⟨β, hβ⟩)
        (f_mem ⟨β, hβ⟩) (ef_sl2 ⟨β, hβ⟩).f_ne_zero (f_mem_S ⟨β, hβ⟩) hα.2 (hnb' γ)⟩
  have hneg' : ∀ α β : H.root,
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) →
      (⇑β.1 : H → K) = -⇑α.1 →
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑β.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑β.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) := by
    rintro α β ⟨h1, h2⟩ hβ
    rw [hβ, neg_neg]
    exact ⟨h2, h1⟩
  have hneg : ∀ α : H.root,
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑α.1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) →
      ((∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (⇑((rootSystem H).reflectionPerm α α).1 : H → K), y ∈ S) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ rootSpace H (-⇑((rootSystem H).reflectionPerm α α).1 : H → K), y ∈ S)) :=
    fun α hα ↦ hneg' α _ hα (hrefl α)
  intro α
  first
  | exact b.induction_add α hsimple hneg
      (fun i j k hk hi hj ↦ hadd i j k hi hj (hconv i j k hk))
  | (induction α using b.induction_add <;>
      first
      | (intros; apply hsimple <;> assumption)
      | (intros; apply hneg <;> assumption)
      | (intros; apply hadd <;>
          first
          | assumption

              first
              | assumption

              | (rw [add_comm]; exact Eq.symm ‹_›)))

          first
          | assumption
          | (apply hconv' <;>
              first
              | assumption

  | (refine b.induction_add ?_ ?_ ?_ α <;>

      | (intros; apply hadd <;>
          first

          | (apply hconv <;>
              first
              | assumption
              | exact Eq.symm ‹_›
              | (rw [add_comm]; assumption)
              | (rw [add_comm]; exact Eq.symm ‹_›)))
      | (intros; apply hneg' <;>
          first

              first
              | assumption

  | (refine b.induction_add ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
      first

      | (intros; apply hadd <;>
          first
          | assumption

              first
              | assumption
              | exact Eq.symm ‹_›

have hD : ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[K] V, finrank K (V ⧸ g.fixedSubmodule) ≤ 1 →
      g ∈ dilatransvections K V := by
    intro g hg
    rw [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank]
    first
      | exact hg
      | refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hg
        rw [fixedSubmodule_eq_ker]
        exact (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange _).finrank_eq.symm
      | have := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank g.fixedSubmodule
        omega
  have hfixOf : ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[K] V, g.fixedReduce = 1 → ∀ x, g x - x ∈ g.fixedSubmodule := by
    intro g hg x
    have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun hg (Submodule.Quotient.mk x)
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.eq]
    first
      | exact h1
      | simpa using h1
      | simpa [fixedReduce] using h1
  have hredOf : ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[K] V, (∀ x, g x - x ∈ g.fixedSubmodule) → g.fixedReduce = 1 := by
    intro g hg
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
    have h1 := hg x
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.eq] at h1
    first
      | exact h1
      | simpa using h1
      | simpa [fixedReduce] using h1
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) = n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  induction n generalizing e with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1 = 0 := by omega
    rw [h0, pow_zero, one_mul]
    exact hD e (by omega)
  | succ n hind =>
    rcases n with _ | m
    · have h0 : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1 = 0 := by omega
      rw [h0, pow_zero, one_mul]
      exact hD e (by omega)
    · have hfix := hfixOf e he
      have h1 : 1 < finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) := by omega
      have hlt : e.fixedSubmodule < ⊤ :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt le_sup_left (sup_span_singleton_lt_top 0 h1)
      obtain ⟨f, hf0, hfW⟩ : ∃ f : Dual K V, f ≠ 0 ∧ e.fixedSubmodule ≤ LinearMap.ker f := by
        first
          | exact Submodule.exists_le_ker_of_lt_top _ hlt
          | exact Submodule.exists_le_ker_of_lt_top hlt
          | obtain ⟨v, -, hpv⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hlt
            obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
              (LinearPMap.supSpanSingleton ⟨e.fixedSubmodule, 0⟩ v (1 : K) hpv).toFun.exists_extend
            refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
            · rintro rfl
              rw [LinearMap.zero_comp] at hg
              have := LinearPMap.supSpanSingleton_apply_mk ⟨e.fixedSubmodule, 0⟩ v (1 : K) hpv 0
                e.fixedSubmodule.zero_mem 1
              simpa using (LinearMap.congr_fun hg _).trans this
            · refine fun x hx => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 ?_
              have := LinearPMap.supSpanSingleton_apply_mk ⟨e.fixedSubmodule, 0⟩ v (1 : K) hpv x
                hx 0
              simpa using (LinearMap.congr_fun hg _).trans this
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, f v ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        first
          | exact hf0 (LinearMap.ext hcon)
          | exact hf0 (LinearMap.ext fun x => by rw [hcon x, LinearMap.zero_apply])
          | exact hf0 (LinearMap.ext fun x => by simp [hcon x])
      obtain ⟨u, hfu⟩ : ∃ u, f u = 1 := by
        refine ⟨(f v)⁻¹ • v, ?_⟩
        first
          | rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv]
          | simp [hv]
          | rw [LinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv]
      have hu' : u ∉ e.fixedSubmodule := by
        intro h
        have h2 := hfW h
        rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hfu] at h2
        exact one_ne_zero h2
      have hτ : f (e u - u) = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hfW (hfix u))
      have hle : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e u - u) ≤ LinearMap.ker f := by
        rw [sup_le_iff, Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
        exact ⟨hfW, hfW (hfix u)⟩
      have hfue : f (u - e u) = 0 := by
        rw [← neg_sub, map_neg, hτ, neg_zero]
      have ht_apply : ∀ y, auxTransvection hle y = y + f y • (u - e u) := by
        intro y
        first
          | rfl
          | simp [auxTransvection, LinearMap.transvection.apply]
          | simp [auxTransvection, transvection.apply]
          | simp [auxTransvection]
      have hτ_apply : ∀ y, transvection hτ y = y + f y • (e u - u) := by
        intro y
        first
          | rfl
          | exact transvection.apply hτ y
          | simp [LinearMap.transvection.apply]
          | simp [transvection.apply]
      have hτt : transvection hτ * auxTransvection hle = 1 := by
        ext y
        show transvection hτ (auxTransvection hle y) = y
        have hfy : f (y + f y • (u - e u)) = f y := by
          first
            | rw [map_add, map_smul, hfue, smul_zero, add_zero]
            | rw [map_add, LinearMap.map_smul, hfue, smul_zero, add_zero]
            | simp [hfue]
        rw [ht_apply, hτ_apply, hfy, add_assoc, ← smul_add, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_self,
          smul_zero, add_zero]
      have hfixte : ∀ x, (auxTransvection hle * e) x - x ∈
          (auxTransvection hle * e).fixedSubmodule := by
        intro x
        rw [auxTransvection_mul_fixed (hf := hle) hfu, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ht_apply]
        apply Submodule.mem_sup_left
        have h2 : u - e u ∈ e.fixedSubmodule := by
          rw [← neg_sub]
          exact neg_mem (hfix u)
        rw [add_sub_right_comm]
        first
          | exact add_mem (hfix x) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h2)
          | exact add_mem (hfix x) (Submodule.smul_mem _ h2)
      have hrank : finrank K (V ⧸ (auxTransvection hle * e).fixedSubmodule) = m + 1 := by
        have := finrank_mod_auxTransvection_mul_fixed (hf := hle) hfu hu'
        omega
      have key : auxTransvection hle * e ∈ transvections K V ^
          (finrank K (V ⧸ (auxTransvection hle * e).fixedSubmodule) - 1) *
            dilatransvections K V := by
        first
          | exact hind (hredOf _ hfixte) hrank
          | exact hind _ (hredOf _ hfixte) hrank
          | exact hind (e := auxTransvection hle * e) (hredOf _ hfixte) hrank
      have hexp1 : finrank K (V ⧸ (auxTransvection hle * e).fixedSubmodule) - 1 = m := by
        omega
      rw [hexp1] at key
      have hτmem : transvection hτ ∈ transvections K V := by
        first
          | exact transvection_mem_transvections hτ
          | exact ⟨f, e u - u, hτ, rfl⟩
          | exact mem_transvections hτ
          | exact ⟨e u - u, f, hτ, rfl⟩
          | exact ⟨⟨(f, e u - u), hτ⟩, rfl⟩
          | exact ⟨f, e u - u, hτ, by ext; simp⟩
      have he' : transvection hτ * (auxTransvection hle * e) = e := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, hτt, one_mul]
      have hmem := Set.mul_mem_mul hτmem key
      rw [he'] at hmem
      have hexp : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1 = m + 1 := by omega
      rw [hexp, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
      exact hmem

obtain ⟨V, hV_open, hV_conv, hV_zero, hV_symm, hV_add, hV_basis⟩ : ∃ V : ℕ → Set β,
      (∀ n, IsOpen (V n)) ∧ (∀ n, Convex ℝ (V n)) ∧ (∀ n, (0 : β) ∈ V n) ∧
      (∀ n, V n = -V n) ∧ (∀ n, V (n + 1) + V (n + 1) ⊆ V n) ∧
      (∀ U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : β), ∃ n, V n ⊆ U) := by
    have good : ∀ U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : β), ∃ s : Set β, IsOpen s ∧ Convex ℝ s ∧ (0 : β) ∈ s ∧
        s = -s ∧ s ⊆ U := by
      intro U hU
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hsU⟩ : ∃ s : Set β, (IsOpen s ∧ Convex ℝ s ∧ (0 : β) ∈ s) ∧ s ⊆ U := by
        first
        | obtain ⟨s, ⟨hs0, hso, hsc⟩, hsU⟩ :=
            (LocallyConvexSpace.convex_open_basis_zero (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := β)).mem_iff.mp hU
          exact ⟨s, ⟨hso, hsc, hs0⟩, hsU⟩
        | obtain ⟨s, ⟨hs0, hso, hsc⟩, hsU⟩ :=
            (nhds_hasBasis_absConvex_open (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := β)).mem_iff.mp hU
          exact ⟨s, ⟨hso, hsc.2, hs0⟩, hsU⟩
        | obtain ⟨s, ⟨hs0, hso, hsc⟩, hsU⟩ :=
            (nhds_basis_abs_convex_open (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := β)).mem_iff.mp hU
          exact ⟨s, ⟨hso, hsc.2, hs0⟩, hsU⟩
        | obtain ⟨s, ⟨hsn, hsc⟩, hsU⟩ :=
            (LocallyConvexSpace.convex_basis (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : β)).mem_iff.mp hU
          exact ⟨interior s, ⟨isOpen_interior, hsc.interior,
            mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hsn⟩, interior_subset.trans hsU⟩
      refine ⟨s ∩ -s, hs.1.inter hs.1.neg, hs.2.1.inter hs.2.1.neg,
        ⟨hs.2.2, by simpa using hs.2.2⟩, ?_, fun y hy => hsU hy.1⟩
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_neg, neg_neg]
      first
      | exact and_comm
      | tauto
    have good2 : ∀ U : Set β, ∃ s : Set β, U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : β) →
        IsOpen s ∧ Convex ℝ s ∧ (0 : β) ∈ s ∧ s = -s ∧ s + s ⊆ U := by
      intro U
      by_cases hU : U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : β)
      · obtain ⟨W, hW, hWU⟩ : ∃ W ∈ 𝓝 (0 : β), ∀ v ∈ W, ∀ w ∈ W, v + w ∈ U := by
          first
          | exact exists_nhds_zero_half hU
          | obtain ⟨W, hWo, hW0, hWU⟩ := exists_open_nhds_zero_half hU
            exact ⟨W, hWo.mem_nhds hW0, hWU⟩
        obtain ⟨s, hso, hsc, hs0, hss, hsW⟩ := good W hW
        refine ⟨s, fun _ => ⟨hso, hsc, hs0, hss, ?_⟩⟩
        rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
        exact hWU a (hsW ha) b (hsW hb)
      · exact ⟨∅, fun h => absurd h hU⟩
    choose S hS using good2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (𝓝 (0 : β)).exists_antitone_basis
    obtain ⟨A, hA0, hAs⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ → Set β, A 0 = u 0 ∧
        ∀ n, A (n + 1) = u (n + 1) ∩ S (A n) :=
      ⟨fun n => Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => Set β) (u 0) (fun k Ak => u (k + 1) ∩ S Ak) n,
        rfl, fun n => rfl⟩
    have hA : ∀ n, A n ∈ 𝓝 (0 : β) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        rw [hA0]
        exact hu.toHasBasis.mem_of_mem trivial
      | succ n ihn =>
        rw [hAs]
        exact Filter.inter_mem (hu.toHasBasis.mem_of_mem trivial)
          ((hS _ ihn).1.mem_nhds (hS _ ihn).2.2.1)
    have hV5 : ∀ n, S (A (n + 1)) + S (A (n + 1)) ⊆ S (A n) := by
      intro n
      refine (hS _ (hA (n + 1))).2.2.2.2.trans ?_
      rw [hAs]
      exact fun y hy => hy.2
    have hV6 : ∀ U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : β), ∃ n, S (A n) ⊆ U := by
      intro U hU
      obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hu.toHasBasis.mem_iff.mp hU
      refine ⟨i, fun y hy => hi ?_⟩
      have hy' : y + 0 ∈ A i :=
        (hS _ (hA i)).2.2.2.2 (Set.add_mem_add hy (hS _ (hA i)).2.2.1)
      rw [add_zero] at hy'
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        rw [hA0] at hy'
        exact hy'
      | succ k =>
        rw [hAs] at hy'
        exact hy'.1
    exact ⟨fun n => S (A n), fun n => (hS _ (hA n)).1, fun n => (hS _ (hA n)).2.1,
      fun n => (hS _ (hA n)).2.2.1, fun n => (hS _ (hA n)).2.2.2.1, hV5, hV6⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg_cont, hg_mem⟩ : ∃ g : α → β, Continuous g ∧ ∀ x, g x ∈ f x + V 0 :=
    HasOpenLowerSections.exists_continuous_selection (f := fun x => f x + V 0)
      (hf.hasOpenCGraph_of_add_hasOpenCGraph (.const (hV_open 0))).hasOpenLowerSections
      (fun x => ⟨_, Set.add_mem_add (hf_nonempty x).some_mem (hV_zero 0)⟩)
      (fun x => (hf_convex x).add (hV_conv 0))
  obtain ⟨h, hh_cont, hh_mem, hh_mem_ball⟩ : ∃ h : ℕ → α → β, (∀ n, Continuous (h n)) ∧
      (∀ n x, h n x ∈ f x + (V n)) ∧
      (∀ n x, h (n + 1) x ∈ {h n x} + V n) := by
    have step : ∀ n (G : {g : α → β // Continuous g ∧ ∀ x, g x ∈ f x + V n}),
        ∃ G' : {g : α → β // Continuous g ∧ ∀ x, g x ∈ f x + V (n + 1)},
          ∀ x, G'.1 x ∈ {G.1 x} + V n := by
      intro n G
      obtain ⟨g', hg'c, hg'1, hg'2⟩ :=
        LowerHemicontinuous.exists_continuous_selection_refine hf hf_convex G.2.1
          (hV_open (n + 1)) (hV_conv (n + 1)) (hV_open n) (hV_conv n) (hV_zero (n + 1))
          (hV_symm n) G.2.2
      exact ⟨⟨g', hg'c, hg'1⟩, hg'2⟩
    choose F hF using step
    obtain ⟨H, hHs⟩ : ∃ H : (n : ℕ) → {g : α → β // Continuous g ∧ ∀ x, g x ∈ f x + V n},
        ∀ n, H (n + 1) = F n (H n) :=
      ⟨fun n => Nat.rec (motive := fun n => {g : α → β // Continuous g ∧ ∀ x, g x ∈ f x + V n})
        ⟨g, hg_cont, hg_mem⟩ (fun k G => F k G) n, fun n => rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun n => (H n).1, fun n => (H n).2.1, fun n => (H n).2.2, fun n x => ?_⟩
    show (H (n + 1)).1 x ∈ {(H n).1 x} + V n
    rw [hHs n]
    exact hF n (H n) x
  have hanti : Antitone V := by
    refine antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun n y hy => hV_add n ?_
    rw [← add_zero y]
    exact Set.add_mem_add hy (hV_zero (n + 1))
  have hneg : ∀ n y, y ∈ V n → -y ∈ V n := by
    intro n y hy
    rw [hV_symm n] at hy

      | exact (MeasureTheory.Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_le m'_le).ae_le h2
      | exact MeasureTheory.ae_mono m'_le h2
      | exact MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_mono m'_le h2
  have e3 : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → ∫⁻ x, ‖s.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x‖ₑ ∂μ = μ s := by
    intro s hs

      | (rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator_const hs, one_mul])

    intro s hs

      | (have h4 : eLpNorm (φ s) 1 μ ≤ eLpNorm (s.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))) 1 μ := by

             | exact MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_one_condExp_le_eLpNorm

  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E, P = ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPapp : ∀ (c : ℝ) (v : E), P c v = c • v := by
    intro c v
    subst hP
    first
      | rfl
      | exact ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply c v
      | simp

    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun c ↦ ?_)
    rw [one_mul]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg c) (fun v ↦ ?_)
    exact le_of_eq (by rw [hPapp, norm_smul])

      | (rw [← ofReal_norm]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_one.2 hP1')
      | (rw [← ofReal_norm_eq_enorm]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_one.2 hP1')
      | (rw [enorm_eq_nnnorm]; exact_mod_cast hP1')

      F s = if MeasurableSet s then ∫ᵛ x, φ s x ∂[P; m'] else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  have hFle : ∀ s, ‖F s‖ₑ ≤ μ s := by

    · simp

    rw [hF, hF, hF, if_pos (hs.union ht), if_pos hs, if_pos ht]
    first
      | exact (integral_congr_ae (hφadd s t hs ht hst)).trans

    intro s hs

  refine ⟨of_additive_of_le_measure F hFle hFadd hFnm, fun s hs ↦ ?_, hFle⟩

      ∫ᵛ x in a ∪ b, f x ∂[B; μ] = ∫ᵛ x in a, f x ∂[B; μ] + ∫ᵛ x in b, f x ∂[B; μ] := by
    intro a b ha hb hab has hbs
    rw [← integral_indicator ha, ← integral_indicator hb, ← integral_indicator (ha.union hb),

    intro N

    | zero =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_zero]

    | succ N ih =>
      have hAN : MeasurableSet (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, s n) :=
        Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ (fun n _ ↦ hm n)
      have hdN : Disjoint (s N) (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, s n) := by
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        intro x hx hx'
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, exists_prop] at hx'
        obtain ⟨n, hn, hxn⟩ := hx'
        exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hd (show N ≠ n by omega)) hx hxn
      have hsubN : (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, s n) ⊆ ⋃ i, s i :=
        Set.iUnion₂_subset fun n _ ↦ Set.subset_iUnion s n
      have hsplitN : (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), s n) = s N ∪ ⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, s n := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, exists_prop]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨n, hn, hxn⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n N with h | h
          · exact Or.inr ⟨n, h, hxn⟩
          · have hnN : n = N := by omega
            rw [hnN] at hxn
            exact Or.inl hxn
        · rintro (hxN | ⟨n, hn, hxn⟩)
          · exact ⟨N, by omega, hxN⟩
          · exact ⟨n, by omega, hxn⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ← ih, hsplitN]

  have hsplit : ∀ N, ⋃ n, s n = (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, s n) ∪ ⋃ n, s (n + N) := by
    intro N
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, exists_prop]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n N with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨n, h, hn⟩
      · refine Or.inr ⟨n - N, ?_⟩
        rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel h]
    · rintro (⟨n, -, hn⟩ | ⟨n, hn⟩)
      · exact ⟨n, hn⟩
      · exact ⟨n + N, hn⟩
  apply hS.hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat.2
  rw [tendsto_iff_enorm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds
    (ENNReal.tendsto_sum_nat_add _ I.ne) (fun _ ↦ by simp) (fun N ↦ ?_)
  have hA : MeasurableSet (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, s n) :=
    Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ (fun n _ ↦ hm n)
  have hR : MeasurableSet (⋃ n, s (n + N)) := MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun n ↦ hm (n + N))
  have hdisj : Disjoint (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, s n) (⋃ n, s (n + N)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hx'
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, exists_prop] at hx hx'
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := hx'

  have hAsub : (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, s n) ⊆ ⋃ i, s i :=
    Set.iUnion₂_subset fun n _ ↦ Set.subset_iUnion s n
  have hRsub : (⋃ n, s (n + N)) ⊆ ⋃ i, s i :=
    Set.iUnion_subset fun n ↦ Set.subset_iUnion s (n + N)
  have hdR : Pairwise (Disjoint on fun n ↦ s (n + N)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact hd (show i + N ≠ j + N by omega)
  have key : ∫ᵛ x in ⋃ n, s n, f x ∂[B; μ] - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∫ᵛ x in s i, f x ∂[B; μ]
      = ∫ᵛ x in ⋃ n, s (n + N), f x ∂[B; μ] := by
    rw [← hfs N, hsplit N, hadd _ _ hA hR hdisj hAsub hRsub]
    abel

    ∑' k, ‖B‖ₑ * ∫⁻ x in s (k + N), ‖f x‖ₑ ∂μ.variation
  rw [enorm_sub_rev, key]
  calc ‖∫ᵛ x in ⋃ n, s (n + N), f x ∂[B; μ]‖ₑ
      ≤ ‖B‖ₑ * ∫⁻ x in ⋃ n, s (n + N), ‖f x‖ₑ ∂μ.variation :=
        enorm_setIntegral_le_lintegral_enorm
    _ = ∑' k, ‖B‖ₑ * ∫⁻ x in s (k + N), ‖f x‖ₑ ∂μ.variation := by
        rw [lintegral_iUnion (fun n ↦ hm (n + N)) hdR, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]

               Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_trans w.2 h), Fin.val_inj])
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + r := ⟨n - r, (Nat.sub_add_cancel h).symm⟩
        have ihk := ih k (by omega)
        rw [turanNumber_add, ihk, Nat.add_mod_right]
        have hsq : (k % r) ^ 2 ≤ k ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.mod_le k r) 2
        have hchoose : r.choose 2 * 2 = r * (r - 1) := by
          rw [Nat.choose_two_right, Nat.div_two_mul_two_of_even (Nat.even_mul_pred_self r)]
        have hexp : (k + r) ^ 2 = k ^ 2 + 2 * k * r + r ^ 2 := by
          first
            | exact add_sq k r
            | exact add_pow_two k r
            | (simp only [pow_two, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.two_mul, Nat.mul_comm r k]; omega)
        have e1 : (k + r) ^ 2 - (k % r) ^ 2 = (k ^ 2 - (k % r) ^ 2) + (2 * k * r + r ^ 2) := by
          first
            | rw [hexp, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_comm hsq]
            | omega
        have h3 : r ^ 2 * (r - 1) = 2 * r * r.choose 2 := by
          calc r ^ 2 * (r - 1) = r * (r * (r - 1)) := by
                first
                  | rw [pow_two, Nat.mul_assoc]
                  | rw [sq, Nat.mul_assoc]
            _ = r * (r.choose 2 * 2) := by rw [hchoose]
            _ = 2 * r * r.choose 2 := by
                first
                  | ac_rfl
                  | (simp only [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm]; done)
        have h4 : 2 * k * r * (r - 1) = 2 * r * (k * (r - 1)) := by
          first
            | ac_rfl
            | (simp only [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm]; done)
        have h2 : (2 * k * r + r ^ 2) * (r - 1) = 2 * r * (k * (r - 1) + r.choose 2) := by
          rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, h3, h4]
        have key : ((k + r) ^ 2 - (k % r) ^ 2) * (r - 1) =
            (k ^ 2 - (k % r) ^ 2) * (r - 1) + 2 * r * (k * (r - 1) + r.choose 2) := by
          rw [e1, Nat.add_mul, h2]
        have hdiv : ((k ^ 2 - (k % r) ^ 2) * (r - 1) + 2 * r * (k * (r - 1) + r.choose 2)) /
            (2 * r) = (k ^ 2 - (k % r) ^ 2) * (r - 1) / (2 * r) + (k * (r - 1) + r.choose 2) :=
          Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by omega)
        rw [key, hdiv]
        omega

suffices key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (H : Subgroup G) (hdvd : p ^ n ∣ Nat.card H) (s : Set (Subgroup G))
      (hchain : IsChain (· ≤ ·) s) (hcard : ∀ K ∈ s, Nat.card K ∣ p ^ n)
      (hle : ∀ K ∈ s, K ≤ H),
      ∃ f : Fin (n + 1) ↪o Subgroup G, s ⊆ Set.range f ∧
        ∀ k, Nat.card (f k) = p ^ k.val ∧ f k ≤ H by
    obtain ⟨f, hf1, hf2⟩ := key n ⊤ (by first | rwa [Subgroup.card_top] | simpa using hdvd) s
      hchain hcard (fun _ _ => _root_.le_top)
    exact ⟨f, hf1, fun k => (hf2 k).1⟩
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro H hdvd s hchain hcard hle
    refine ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono (fun _ => ⊥) (fun a b hab => ?_), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exfalso
      have h1 : (a : ℕ) < b := by
        first
          | exact hab
          | exact Fin.lt_def.mp hab
          | exact Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val.mp hab
      have h2 := b.isLt
      omega
    · intro L hL
      have hLbot : L = ⊥ := by
        have h1 := hcard L hL
        rw [pow_zero, Nat.dvd_one] at h1
        first
          | exact Subgroup.eq_bot_of_card_eq L h1
          | exact Subgroup.card_eq_one.mp h1
      exact ⟨0, hLbot.symm⟩
    · intro k
      have hk : (k : ℕ) = 0 := by
        have := k.isLt
        omega
      refine ⟨?_, _root_.bot_le⟩
      show Nat.card (⊥ : Subgroup G) = p ^ (k : ℕ)
      rw [hk, pow_zero, Subgroup.card_bot]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro H hdvd s hchain hcard hle
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀card, hL₀H, hsL₀⟩ : ∃ L₀ : Subgroup G, Nat.card L₀ ∣ p ^ (n + 1) ∧
        L₀ ≤ H ∧ ∀ L ∈ s, L ≤ L₀ := by
      rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hs | hs
      · refine ⟨⊥, ?_, _root_.bot_le, ?_⟩
        · rw [Subgroup.card_bot]
          exact _root_.one_dvd _
        · intro L hL
          rw [hs] at hL
          simp at hL
      · have hex : ∃ L₀ ∈ s, ∀ L ∈ s, Nat.card L ≤ Nat.card L₀ := by
          first
            | (have : Nonempty ↥s := hs.to_subtype
               obtain ⟨⟨L₀, hL₀s⟩, hmax⟩ :=
                 Finite.exists_max (fun L : ↥s => Nat.card (L : Subgroup G))
               exact ⟨L₀, hL₀s, fun L hL => hmax ⟨L, hL⟩⟩)
            | (obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀s, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image s.toFinite.toFinset
                 (fun L : Subgroup G => Nat.card L) (by simpa using hs)
               exact ⟨L₀, by simpa using hL₀s, fun L hL => hmax L (by simpa using hL)⟩)
        obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀s, hmax⟩ := hex
        refine ⟨L₀, hcard L₀ hL₀s, hle L₀ hL₀s, fun L hL => ?_⟩
        rcases eq_or_ne L L₀ with h | h
        · exact h.le
        · rcases hchain hL hL₀s h with h' | h'
          · exact h'
          · exact (Subgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge h' (hmax L hL)).symm.le
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hL₀K, hKH⟩ := exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime_le_le hp hL₀card hdvd hL₀H
    have hs'card : ∀ L ∈ {L | L ∈ s ∧ L ≠ K}, Nat.card L ∣ p ^ n := by
      rintro L ⟨hLs, hLK⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hLj⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp).mp (hcard L hLs)
      have hjn : j ≤ n := by
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n j with hnj | hnj
        · exfalso
          apply hLK
          apply Subgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge ((hsL₀ L hLs).trans hL₀K)
          rw [hK, hLj]
          exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp.pos (by omega)
        · exact hnj
      rw [hLj]
      exact _root_.pow_dvd_pow p hjn
    have hs'sub : {L | L ∈ s ∧ L ≠ K} ⊆ s := fun L hL => hL.1
    obtain ⟨f', hf's, hf'⟩ := ih K (by rw [hK]; exact _root_.pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n))
      {L | L ∈ s ∧ L ≠ K} (hchain.mono hs'sub) hs'card
      (fun L hL => (hsL₀ L hL.1).trans hL₀K)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → Subgroup G,
        ∀ k, g k = if h : (k : ℕ) < n + 1 then f' ⟨(k : ℕ), h⟩ else K :=
      ⟨fun k => if h : (k : ℕ) < n + 1 then f' ⟨(k : ℕ), h⟩ else K, fun k => rfl⟩
    have hgK : ∀ k, g k ≤ K := by
      intro k
      by_cases h : (k : ℕ) < n + 1
      · rw [hg, dif_pos h]
        exact (hf' _).2
      · exact (show g k = K by rw [hg, dif_neg h]).le
    have hgcard : ∀ k : Fin (n + 1 + 1), Nat.card (g k) = p ^ (k : ℕ) := by
      intro k
      by_cases h : (k : ℕ) < n + 1
      · rw [hg, dif_pos h]
        exact (hf' _).1
      · have hk2 := k.isLt
        rw [hg, dif_neg h, hK, show (k : ℕ) = n + 1 by omega]
    have hgmono : Monotone g := by
      intro a b hab
      have hab' : (a : ℕ) ≤ b := by
        first
          | exact hab
          | exact Fin.le_def.mp hab
          | exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hab
      by_cases hb : (b : ℕ) < n + 1
      · have ha : (a : ℕ) < n + 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hab' hb
        rw [hg a, hg b, dif_pos ha, dif_pos hb]
        first
          | exact f'.monotone (show (⟨(a : ℕ), ha⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) ≤ ⟨(b : ℕ), hb⟩ from hab')
          | exact f'.monotone (Fin.le_def.mpr hab')
          | exact f'.le_iff_le.mpr (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr hab')
      · rw [hg b, dif_neg hb]
        exact hgK a
    have hginj : Function.Injective g := by
      intro a b hab
      have h1 : p ^ (a : ℕ) = p ^ (b : ℕ) := by
        rw [← hgcard a, ← hgcard b, hab]
      first
        | exact Fin.ext (Nat.pow_right_injective hp.two_le h1)
        | exact Fin.ext (Nat.pow_right_injective (Nat.Prime.two_le hp) h1)
    refine ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono g (hgmono.strictMono_of_injective hginj), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro L hL
      rcases eq_or_ne L K with hLK | hLK
      · have hlast : ¬ ((Fin.last (n + 1) : ℕ) < n + 1) := by
          first
            | simp
            | exact lt_irrefl _
        refine ⟨Fin.last (n + 1), ?_⟩
        show g (Fin.last (n + 1)) = L
        rw [hLK, hg, dif_neg hlast]
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hf's (show L ∈ {L | L ∈ s ∧ L ≠ K} from ⟨hL, hLK⟩)
        subst hj
        refine ⟨⟨(j : ℕ), by have := j.isLt; omega⟩, ?_⟩
        show g ⟨(j : ℕ), _⟩ = f' j
        first
          | (rw [hg, dif_pos j.isLt]; done)
          | (rw [hg, dif_pos j.isLt]; rfl)
          | (simp [hg]; done)
          | (rw [hg]; simp)
    · intro k
      first
        | exact ⟨hgcard k, (hgK k).trans hKH⟩
        | (simp only [OrderEmbedding.coe_ofStrictMono]; exact ⟨hgcard k, (hgK k).trans hKH⟩)

have hR0 : ‖w‖ ≠ |R| := fun h => hw (mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr h)

    rintro rfl

  have hA : ∀ᶠ x in nhds w, AEStronglyMeasurable

    first

  have hB : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun θ : ℝ => herglotzRieszKernel 0 w (circleMap 0 R θ) • f (circleMap 0 R θ))

    have hI : IntervalIntegrable

    first

    have hdist := hkey t x hx

    rw [_root_.norm_smul]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (_root_.norm_nonneg _)

        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ (1 - t) ^ (n + 1)) (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) t := by
      intro t _
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ 1 - t) (-1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub 1
      have h2 := h1.pow (n + 1)
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h2
      convert h2 using 1 <;> first | ring | rfl | (funext s; simp)
    have hv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y))
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1 + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at ht
      exact hderiv (n + 1) t (hf t ht)
    have hcu : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ (1 - t) ^ (n + 1)) := by fun_prop
    have hcu' : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ -(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) := by fun_prop
    have hcv : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y))
        (Set.uIcc 0 1) := hcont n hf'
    have hcv' : ContinuousOn
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1 + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y))
        (Set.uIcc 0 1) := hcont (n + 1) hf
    have hint1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ (1 - t) ^ (n + 1) •
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1 + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hcu.continuousOn.smul hcv').intervalIntegrable
    have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) •
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hcu'.continuousOn.smul hcv).intervalIntegrable
    have hIBP0 : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) ^ (n + 1) •
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1 + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)
        = ((1 : ℝ) - 1) ^ (n + 1) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + (1 : ℝ) • y) (fun _ ↦ y)
          - ((1 : ℝ) - 0) ^ (n + 1) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + (0 : ℝ) • y) (fun _ ↦ y)
          - ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) •
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y) := by
      have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (fun t ht ↦ (hu t ht).smul (hv t ht)) (hint1.add hint2)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hint1 hint2] at hFTC
      exact eq_sub_of_add_eq hFTC
    have e1 : ((1 : ℝ) - 1) ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by simp
    have e2 : ((1 : ℝ) - 0) ^ (n + 1) = 1 := by simp
    have e3 : x + (0 : ℝ) • y = x := by simp
    have e4 : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - t) ^ n)) •
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)
        = -(((n : ℝ) + 1) • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) ^ n •
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)) := by
      first
        | simp only [neg_smul, mul_smul, intervalIntegral.integral_neg,
            intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
        | simp [neg_smul, mul_smul, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
    rw [e1, e2, zero_smul, one_smul, e3, e4] at hIBP0
    have hb : (((n + 1)! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((n : ℝ) + 1) = ((n ! : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      have h2 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      first
        | rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add_one, mul_inv, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
            mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, one_mul]
        | (rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add_one]
           field_simp)
    rw [ih hf', Finset.sum_range_succ _ (n + 1), add_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [hIBP0, smul_sub, smul_sub, smul_zero, smul_neg, smul_smul, hb]
    abel
exact (by norm_num : (2:ℕ) + 2 = 5)
